This position requires an experienced systems programmer supporting the z/OS Mainframe Network environment. Responsibilities include configuring and maintaining the integrity and data/IP security of the Mainframe's host communication subsystems and associated program products. Your responsibilities will include: Being part of a multi-functional team, supporting IBM mainframe networks and transmissions products and infrastructure. Participation in support rota providing 24x7 cover. Perform TCPIP Port Reserves (Additions, Deletions, Changes) Perform VTAM updates (Additions, Deletions, Changes) Manage OSA Adapters in a complex mainframe environment Perform VTAM PU/LU updates (Additions, Deletions, Changes) including Enterprise Extenders (EE) Implement AT-TLS rules (digital certificate management). Knowledge of z/OS and z/OS utilities. Understanding of z/OS networking services, structure and related software and protocols. Understanding of network security disciplines (IPSec, TLS/SSL, certificates, etc) and how they relate to file transmission. Experience of problem management from initial diagnosis through to resolution. Understanding of the Change Management process. Ability to customize and manage secure SNA and TCP/IP networks under z/OS. Knowledge of mainframe network management tools, e.g. NetMaster, and multi-session manager products such as TUBES and Supersession. Experience of managing mainframe printing products. General z/OS systems programming experience. Knowledge of System z hardware including the OSA-Express network cards. Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills Good communication, teamwork and negotiation skills Familiarity with the Cisco Network Solutions The ability to work to tight deadlines under pressure Good organisational skills Flexibility and adaptability The ability to create and maintain strong working relationships with colleagues and customers Business awareness and understanding of business requirements of IT A willingness to keep up to date with developments in new technology An understanding of information legislation, such as the Data Protection Act. review_candidates.title: Information and Communications Technology (ICT) Officer (P)
review_candidates.description: Job Description Introduction Established in 1951, IOM is a Related Organization of the United Nations and the leading UN agency in the field of migration. Working closely with governmental, intergovernmental, and non-governmental partners, IOM promotes humane and orderly migration for the benefit of all. It saves lives and protects people on the move, drives solutions to displacement, and facilitates pathways for regular migration, while providing services and advice to governments and migrants. IOM is committed to fostering a respectful, inclusive, and supportive workplace where all employees can thrive professionally and feel valued. By creating such an environment, IOM aims to better harness the full potential of migration and strengthen its support to people on the move. IOM invites candidates from diverse backgrounds to apply and provides reasonable accommodation throughout the recruitment process when required. Learn more about IOM’s workplace culture at IOM workplace culture | International Organization for Migration . Applications are welcome from first- and second-tier candidates, particularly qualified female candidates as well as applications from the non-represented member countries of IOM. For all IOM vacancies, applications from qualified and eligible first-tier candidates are considered before those of qualified and eligible second-tier candidates in the selection process. For the purpose of this vacancy, the following are considered first-tier candidates: Internal candidates Candidates from the following IOM Member States that are not represented among staff members in the Professional and higher categories: Bahamas, Barbados, Cabo Verde, Comoros, Congo (the), Cook Islands, Dominica, Federated States of Micronesia, Grenada, Guinea-Bissau, Holy See, Iceland, Israel, Kiribati, Marshall Islands, Namibia, Nauru, Palau, Saint Kitts and Nevis, Saint Lucia, Samoa, Sao Tome and Principe, Seychelles, Solomon Islands, Suriname, Timor-Leste, Tonga, Trinidad and Tobago, Tuvalu, Vanuatu Second Tier Candidates Include All external candidates, except candidates from non-represented member states of IOM. Organizational Context and Scope Under the overall supervision of Chief of Mission (CoM), direct supervision of the Head of Resources Management and in close coordination with relevant staff from ICT department counterparts in the Regional Officer Asia and Pacific (ROAP) and the Department of Information and Communications Technology at HQ, the Information and Communication Technology (ICT) Officer will supervise and coordinate the ICT operations in the Country Office (CO) including its Sub-Offices. Responsibilities Supervise and coordinate the activities of the Information and Communications Technology (ICT) Unit in the Country Office by ensuring that all requirements are addressed in a timely and accurately, with an efficient allocation of resources, and that all operations are in compliance with IOM ICT policies and standards and are in line with the ICT strategy. Coordinate the continuous engagement and liaison with the CO’s management, Heads of units and field operations, for the adequate and timely provision of ICT solutions and services to satisfy operational needs, including emergencies as necessary. Act as the ICT business relationship and cybersecurity local liaison Focal Point with counterparts such as IOM programmes, global cybersecurity programme, Governmental, donors, United Nations Agencies, Non-Governmental Organizations (NGOs), ICT service providers, and Vendors for coordinated and adequate provision of ICT services, digital innovation, technologies and supplies. Participate in the ICT Working Group in the country, representing the CO in discussions and initiatives. Provide technical support for the CO’s ICT services and supervise, train, and equip the CO’s ICT Team to effectively implement strategic initiatives, timely respond to information security incidents, and provide Tier 1 support and escalate to the relevant specialist teams/units, when needed, for immediate corrective/remedial actions. Contribute to the preparation of the CO’s ICT documentation including office-specific Standard Operating Procedures (SOP), Business Continuity Plan, Disaster Recovery Plans and ICT Risk record for the CO’s ICT-related services. Coordinate and monitor the delivery and efficiency of services and redundancy in line with IOM ICT standards while checking that global ICT SOPs are complied with. Contribute to the service improvement assessments and provide recommendations to the CO’s management to optimize and implement ICT Infrastructure and solutions to ensure the efficient functioning of CO’s operations. Maintain and check that all technical specifications for procurement and provision of ICT-related equipment, supplies, services, and technical evaluations are in line with ICT standards and policies, and are adequately managed. Liaise with CO’s Supply Chain Unit to guide on proper provision of ICT-related equipment, supplies, services, and propose the most suitable solutions. In coordination with the ICT Information Security Unit at HQ, act as the Focal Point, the first line of cybersecurity defense, and first local cybersecurity incident responder in the CO. Facilitate the implementation of security and compliance controls of the IOM global cybersecurity programme and compliance with the IOM global cybersecurity, and other compliances required by the donors, operational frameworks and standards. Perform such other duties as may be assigned. Qualifications Required Qualifications and Experience Education Master’s degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Information Management, Information Technology, or a related field from an accredited academic institution with two years of relevant professional experience; or, University degree in the above fields with four years of relevant professional experience. Certificate in any of the following: Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA), Microsoft Azure certifications, Microsoft Certified System Administrator (MCSA), Microsoft Certified Database Administrator (MCDBA), Microsoft Certified System Engineer (MCSE) is a distinct advantage. Accredited Universities are those listed in the UNESCO World Higher Education Database. Experience Experience in overseeing and managing the implementation and administration of Microsoft Windows and serverless network environments (LAN/WAN) and first-level network/desktop support in a large international organization is required; Experience in a supervisory role and management of ICT functions in an international organization or an international agency in a field location; supporting emergency, complex/post-conflict Country Office; Experience in planning, design, development, implementation, and maintenance of computer information systems; Knowledge and demonstrated experience in cybersecurity compliance and security implementation and maintenance, database information systems, and data processing tools. Knowledge of web-based development and other development tools and reporting, including future projections on the potential of current and new technologies; Good knowledge and experience in Microsoft 365 cloud-based applications and technologies; and, Experience providing policy advice to senior managers on systems development in a changing business environment and the implications of various alternatives, on business applications planned for future needs and other related issues. Skills Good oral and written communication skills; refined soft skills and demonstrated ability to communicate with business leaders and those with limited technical background effectively is essential; Good knowledge of Windows Operating System, Network\Systems administration, TCP/IP, Telecoms, Network Protocols, Cisco devices, VPN, VoIP, MS Office 365 apps, Antivirus Software, and utilities; Good knowledge of web-based development, geographical information systems, and/or mapping tools would be a distinctive advantage; Demonstrated ability to work with minimal supervision and demonstrate a high level of initiative, perseverance, and professional commitment to achieve high-quality results; Demonstrated ability to handle confidential data in a professional, responsible, and mature manner; and, Demonstrated ability to train individuals, to work effectively and harmoniously with colleagues within a team from varied cultures and professional backgrounds. Languages For this position, fluency in English is required (oral and written). Working knowledge of another official UN languages (Arabic, Chinese, French, Russian, and Spanish) is an advantage. Proficiency of language(s) required will be specifically evaluated during the selection process, which may include written and/or oral assessments. Required Competencies IOM’s competency framework can be found at this link . Competencies will be assessed during the selection process. Values - all IOM staff members must abide by and demonstrate these five values: Inclusion and respect for diversity: Respects and promotes individual and cultural differences. Encourages diversity and inclusion. Integrity and transparency: Maintains high ethical standards and acts in a manner consistent with organizational principles/rules and standards of conduct. Professionalism: Demonstrates ability to work in a composed, competent and committed manner and exercises careful judgment in meeting day-to-day challenges. Courage: Demonstrates willingness to take a stand on issues of importance. Empathy: Shows compassion for others, makes people feel safe, respected and fairly treated. Core Competencies – behavioural indicators Level 2 Teamwork: Develops and promotes effective collaboration within and across units to achieve shared goals and optimize results. Delivering results: Produces and delivers quality results in a service-oriented and timely manner. Is action-oriented and committed to achieving agreed outcomes. Managing and sharing knowledge: Continuously seeks to learn, share knowledge and innovate. Accountability: Takes ownership for achieving the Organization’s priorities and assumes responsibility for own actions and delegated work. Communication: Encourages and contributes to clear and open communication. Explains complex matters in an informative, inspiring and motivational way. Managerial Competencies – behavioural indicators Level 2 Leadership: Provides a clear sense of direction, leads by example and demonstrates the ability to carry out the Organization’s vision. Assists others to realize and develop their leadership and professional potential. Empowering others: Creates an enabling environment where staff can contribute their best and develop their potential. Building Trust: Promotes shared values and creates an atmosphere of trust and honesty. Strategic thinking and vision: Works strategically to realize the Organization’s goals and communicates a clear strategic direction. Humility: Leads with humility and shows openness to acknowledging own shortcomings. Notes Internationally recruited professional staff are required to be mobile. Please refer to this link for guidance on IOM Job Category. Any offer made to the candidate in relation to this vacancy notice is subject to funding confirmation. This selection process may be used to staff similar positions in various duty stations. Recommended candidates will remain eligible to be appointed in a similar position for a period of 24 months. Appointment will be subject to all clearances, including medical and security, as well as accreditation, and any residency or visa requirements. Vacancies close at 23:59 local time in Geneva, Switzerland on the respective closing date. No late applications will be accepted. IOM has a zero-tolerance policy on conduct that is incompatible with the aims and objectives of the United Nations and IOM, including sexual exploitation and abuse, harassment, sexual harassment, abuse of authority and any forms of discrimination. IOM is committed to promote the protection and safeguarding of all children. IOM conducts reference checks and background verification, including through system-wide databases such as ClearCheck, to help ensure that candidates have no record of misconduct, including on sexual harassment, sexual exploitation and abuse, or fraud. Candidates are expected to uphold these standards and principles at all times. IOM does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process—whether for application, interview, processing, training, or otherwise—and does not request any information related to bank accounts. IOM only accepts duly completed applications submitted through the IOM WAVE system (for internal candidates, link here ). The online tool also allows candidates to track the status of their application. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. For further information and other job postings, you are welcome to visit our website: IOM Careers and Job Vacancies.

review_candidates.title: Video Editor – Interviews & Human Stories
review_candidates.description: We are looking for a talented and thoughtful Video Editor who is particularly strong at editing interviews, conversations, speeches, panels, podcasts, and people-focused content . This is a 100% remote position . While the vacancy is being advertised through LinkedIn in South Africa, you do not need to be based in South Africa to apply . We welcome qualified applicants from different countries and backgrounds. This position is not simply about cutting footage, adding subtitles, or making transitions. We are looking for an editor who can genuinely understand people . You should be able to watch a 30-minute or 60-minute interview and quickly identify: What is this person really trying to say? What is the most interesting idea in the conversation? Which sentence could become a strong short-form video? Where is the emotional or human moment? What makes this speaker different from everyone else? What will make an audience stop scrolling and listen? The right candidate should combine technical editing ability with storytelling, human insight, empathy, creativity, and strong communication skills . What You Will Be Editing Your work may include: One-on-one interviews Executive and founder interviews International conference interviews Speeches and keynote presentations Panel discussions Professional conversations Podcasts Thought-leadership videos Social-media short videos Event highlights Human-interest and documentary-style content A large part of the role involves working with content featuring people from different countries, cultures, industries, professions, and personal backgrounds . Key Responsibilities You will be responsible for: Reviewing long-form interview and event footage. Identifying the strongest ideas, quotes, emotional moments, and insights. Turning long conversations into engaging short-form videos. Editing polished long-form interviews and professional videos. Creating strong opening hooks within the first few seconds. Improving pacing and removing unnecessary or repetitive sections. Knowing when to use pauses rather than cutting too aggressively. Using facial expressions, reactions, and body language effectively. Adding professional subtitles and captions. Selecting suitable B-roll and supporting visuals. Using graphics, text animation, zooms, transitions, and visual emphasis when appropriate. Using music carefully without overpowering the speaker. Improving audio quality and maintaining consistent sound levels. Helping the personality of the interviewee come through naturally. Suggesting stronger story angles when you identify something interesting in the footage. Communicating with the team about creative ideas rather than simply waiting for detailed instructions. What We Are Looking For We are particularly interested in someone with: Strong video editing skills. Excellent storytelling instincts. Experience editing interviews or people-focused content. Strong understanding of human communication. Ability to recognize interesting ideas and meaningful statements. Good emotional awareness and empathy. Strong cross-cultural awareness. Ability to understand different accents and styles of communication. Strong English comprehension. Good written and verbal communication skills. Attention to detail. Good judgment about pacing and audience attention. Ability to work independently in a remote environment. Ability to receive feedback and improve quickly. Strong ownership of final video quality. Technical Skills Experience with one or more of the following is preferred: Adobe Premiere Pro DaVinci Resolve Final Cut Pro Adobe After Effects CapCut Descript AI-assisted video editing tools AI transcription and subtitle tools Audio enhancement tools Experience using AI to help with transcription, identifying highlights, content analysis, subtitles, B-roll research, or editing workflows is welcome. However, AI tools should support your judgment — they should not replace your ability to understand the actual conversation. The Most Important Skill For us, one of the most important abilities is this: Can you understand what makes a person interesting? A technically perfect edit is not enough if the editor misses the strongest idea in the interview. We want someone who can recognize when a speaker says something intelligent, surprising, emotional, controversial, memorable, or highly relevant — and knows how to turn that moment into a strong video. How to Apply Please include: Your CV or brief introduction Your portfolio 2–5 examples of your strongest video editing work At least one example involving an interview, speech, podcast, documentary, or people-focused video if available A short explanation of which video in your portfolio you believe demonstrates your storytelling ability best This is a fully remote position. Applicants from outside South Africa are welcome to apply. 2. Video Editor – Interviews, Storytelling & International Content LinkedIn Location: Malaysia Workplace Type: Fully Remote / Online Employment Type: Remote Position About the Role We are looking for a creative and highly perceptive Video Editor to work primarily on interviews, international conversations, speeches, professional events, and human-centered stories . This is a fully remote online position . The job is being advertised through LinkedIn in Malaysia in order to reach talented candidates in the region, but you are not required to live in Malaysia . Applications are welcome from qualified candidates in other countries as well. We are especially interested in editors who are curious about people, cultures, ideas, and different ways of thinking . You should not approach an interview simply as a collection of clips. You should be able to understand: Who is speaking, why their perspective matters, what their strongest idea is, and how to present that person in a way that makes an audience care. Nature of the Content The content may involve: Entrepreneurs and founders Government representatives International professionals Researchers and academics Technology specialists Executives Young professionals Community leaders International conference participants People from developing and developed countries Speakers from different cultural and professional backgrounds Because of this, cultural sensitivity and empathy are very important . Different people communicate differently. Some speakers may be energetic and expressive. Others may be quiet, thoughtful, technical, or reserved. A strong editor should understand those differences and avoid forcing every person into the same editing style. Main Responsibilities Your responsibilities will include: Watching and understanding long-form interview footage. Selecting the strongest parts of each conversation. Identifying memorable quotes and insights. Finding strong hooks for the opening of short videos. Creating 30-second, 60-second, and several-minute social-media edits. Editing complete interviews and speeches. Creating highlight videos from events and conversations. Structuring clips so that they tell a clear story. Improving pacing without destroying natural conversation. Using silence and pauses intentionally when they strengthen the message. Highlighting important statements through captions, graphics, and visual emphasis. Adding B-roll where it genuinely improves understanding. Selecting suitable music and sound design. Cleaning and balancing audio. Creating professional subtitles. Paying close attention to pronunciation, names, countries, organizations, and technical terminology. Understanding context before making editorial decisions. Suggesting alternative edits or creative approaches when you believe they will improve the final result. Human Insight Is Important This position requires more than software skills. For example, imagine you receive a 45-minute interview . We may ask you to identify: The best 60-second clip. The most emotionally powerful moment. The most intelligent or surprising idea. The best opening sentence. The section most suitable for LinkedIn. The section most suitable for Instagram, TikTok, or YouTube Shorts. What makes this particular person worth listening to. We want an editor who can make those decisions intelligently. Communication Skills Strong communication is also important because you may need to discuss: Why you selected a particular clip. Why you removed a section. Why a video should start at a particular moment. Whether an interview should feel serious, emotional, energetic, intellectual, or inspirational. What you believe the audience will respond to. We value editors who can think and communicate like creative partners , not only execute technical instructions. Requirements The ideal candidate should have: Professional video editing experience. A strong portfolio. Experience with interview, documentary, podcast, speech, event, or social-media editing. Excellent English comprehension. Strong storytelling ability. Good communication skills. Strong empathy. Cultural awareness. Curiosity about people and ideas. Ability to understand different accents and communication styles. Strong attention to detail. Ability to work remotely and independently. Reliability and good time management. Ability to accept feedback professionally. Ability to meet deadlines consistently. Editing Tools Experience with any of the following is useful: Adobe Premiere Pro After Effects DaVinci Resolve Final Cut Pro CapCut Descript Adobe Audition AI video tools AI transcription tools AI-assisted content analysis Knowledge of short-form content editing and social-media storytelling will be a strong advantage. What Will Make You Stand Out You will stand out if you can demonstrate that you are good at: Interview storytelling Understanding personalities Identifying strong ideas Editing international speakers Creating emotional connection Making professional speakers more engaging Finding excellent short-form clips from long-form conversations Creating strong first 2–5 seconds Maintaining natural human emotion rather than over-editing everything

review_candidates.title: Procurement Manager - Renewable Energy / Solar | Wind (USS / GSS / PSS & Civil Structures) | EHV Infrastructure
review_candidates.description: Role Purpose The Procurement Manager will lead end-to-end strategic procurement across three specialised verticals: (1) Solar PV generation assets, (2) Wind energy generation assets including the full substation hierarchy — Unit Substation (USS), Grid Substation (GSS), and Pool Substation (PSS) — with associated 2-pole and 4-pole structural systems, and (3) Extra High Voltage (EHV) transmission & grid infrastructure. The incumbent will drive sourcing excellence, vendor development, cost optimisation, and compliance with CEA/CERC standards and internal governance framework. Key Responsibilities A. Strategic Procurement & Sourcing • Develop and execute integrated procurement strategies for solar, wind (USS/GSS/PSS), and EHV infrastructure — covering equipment, civil works, and O&M services. • Lead global and domestic sourcing; evaluate and onboard OEMs, EPC sub-vendors, and Tier-1 suppliers across all three verticals. • Manage the full tender lifecycle — RFQ/RFP preparation, technical & commercial bid evaluation, techno- commercial negotiations, and award recommendation. • Drive CAPEX benchmarking and ensure procurement targets are met within approved project budgets; identify value engineering opportunities. • Maintain a live vendor rate card and price intelligence database for wind substation equipment, civil structures, and EHV materials. B. Wind Energy Substation Procurement — USS / GSS / PSS This role requires deep expertise in procurement of the complete wind project substation hierarchy: Unit Substation (USS) → Grid Substation (GSS) → Pool Substation (PSS), along with all associated electrical equipment and structural systems. B1. Unit Substation (USS) — Wind Turbine Level • Procure USS (typically 0.69/0.9 kV – 33/66 kV) equipment at each wind turbine generator (WTG) pad: WTG step-up transformers (dry-type or oil-cooled), LV/MV switchgear, and MV vacuum circuit breakers (VCBs). • Source USS enclosures, structural skids, grounding systems, surge protection devices (SPDs), and LV distribution boards. • Manage procurement of WTG ring main units (RMUs), cable termination kits, MV cable joints, and inter-array cable systems (33 kV XLPE underground cables). • Coordinate with WTG OEMs (Vestas, Siemens Gamesa, GE, Suzlon, Envision, Inox) for USS interface specifications and IEC compliance requirements. B2. Grid Substation (GSS) — Collection Substation Level • Lead procurement of GSS equipment aggregating power from multiple USS strings, typically operating at 33 kV / 66 kV / 110 kV voltage levels. • Source GSS power transformers (33/110 kV or 66/132 kV), GIS/AIS switchgear panels, bus bar systems, CTs, PTs, CVTs, and LA/surge arresters. • Manage procurement of GSS protection panels (distance relay, differential relay, REF, overcurrent), SCADA RTUs, and energy metering systems. • Procure GSS civil works packages: pre-engineered buildings (PEB), transformer oil containment pits, cable trenches, drainage, fencing, and access roads. • Source GSS auxiliary systems: DC battery chargers, ACDB/DCDB panels, fire detection & suppression systems, and earthing/lightning protection networks. • Manage RFQ for GSS-level SCADA, RTU integration with wind farm SCADA (WPS), and telecom/fibre-optic infrastructure. B3. Pool Substation (PSS) — Central Wind Farm Substation • Lead procurement of PSS (also referred to as main receiving substation or central pooling substation) equipment operating at 132 kV, 220 kV, or 400 kV levels. • Source PSS EHV power transformers (132/220/400 kV, autotransformers where applicable), GIS/AIS switchgear bays, bus coupler panels, and tie-line equipment. • Manage procurement of PSS protection & control (P&C) panels, numerical relays (line differential, distance, busbar protection), inter-tripping equipment, and PLCC systems. • Source PSS metering cubicles, trivector meters (NABL certified), RLDC/SLDC telemetry and SCADA integration equipment. • Procure PSS civil and structural works: RCC/steel control room buildings, cable trenches, transformer bays, oil containment, boundary walls, and site infrastructure. • Manage statutory approvals and equipment interface documentation with PGCIL/STU/DISCOM for PSS commissioning and grid synchronisation. C. Wind Project Civil & Structural Procurement — 2-Pole & 4-Pole Systems Expertise required in procurement of 2-pole and 4-pole gantry/portal structures used across USS, GSS, and PSS switchyards for conductor termination, bus support, and equipment mounting. Structure Type Application in Wind Projects Key Procurement Scope 2-Pole Structure (A- type / Portal Frame) WTG yard, USS switchyard, GSS 33/66 kV bays, incoming and outgoing line terminations Galvanised MS/GI tubular/lattice poles, crossarms, base plates, anchor bolts, clamps, hardware; fabrication, hot-dip galvanising, and erection contracts 4-Pole Structure (Gantry / H-Frame) GSS and PSS EHV bays (132 kV / 220 kV / 400 kV), bus-bar support structures, equipment platforms, maintenance walkways Structural steel sections (IS 2062), lattice gantry fabrication, galvanising as per IS 4759, levelling pads, foundation bolts, grouting kits; civil foundation works Pole-Mounted Equipment Structures LA/SA mounting, CT/PT mounting, isolator support structures at USS/GSS level Steel channels, angle iron frameworks, pre- galvanised structural hardware, insulator strings, conductor stringing accessories Earthing & Lightning Protection Earth mat, earth electrode, earth strips across USS/GSS/PSS, lightning masts Copper earth strips/rods, GI earth wire, lightning masts (30m/45m), bonding connectors, surge counter meters • Manage procurement of civil foundation works for 2-pole and 4-pole structures: soil investigation, PCC/RCC foundations, stub setting, and backfill. • Source structural steel from SAIL/TATA/JSW-approved mills; ensure IS 2062 Grade compliance, dimensional tolerances, and hot-dip galvanising as per IS 4759. • Coordinate structural design review with Civil/Structural Engineering team and ensure procurement aligns with approved GADs (General Arrangement Drawings). • Manage erection sub-contracts for structural steel work, switchyard civil works, and cabling within USS, GSS, and PSS boundaries. D. EHV Transmission & Grid Infrastructure Procurement • Lead procurement of EHV transmission line materials: ACSR/ACCC/HTLS conductors, ground wires (OPGW/GW), lattice/tubular towers (2-pole/4-pole/delta), disc/string insulators, and hardware fittings. • Source EHV cables (132/220/400 kV XLPE), cable accessories (joints, terminations), and cable management systems for underground sections. • Manage sourcing of PGCIL/STU-grade EHV switchgear: SF6/GIS bays, line isolators, bus isolators, earth switches, and interlocking systems. • Ensure all EHV equipment meets CEA Technical Standards, IS/IEC 60076/62271/60826, and Grid Code requirements; manage FAT/SAT documentation. • Liaise with PGCIL, STUs, and DISCOMs for bay allocation, connectivity milestones, and long-lead equipment planning. E. Solar Equipment Procurement • Oversee procurement of solar PV modules (mono PERC, TOPCon, Bifacial HJT), string/central/hybrid inverters, DC cables, mounting structures, and BoP components. • Source site SCADA, monitoring systems, BESS (Battery Energy Storage Systems), and hybrid integration equipment as required by project scope. • Ensure ALMM compliance for solar modules and cells; manage vendor qualification under BIS/IEC certification requirements. G. Contract, Compliance & Governance • Draft, review, and negotiate procurement contracts (LOIs, MSAs, POs, EPC sub-contracts) in coordination with Legal & Finance teams. • Ensure compliance with MNRE, CERC, CEA, and applicable state regulations across all procurement activities. • Adhere to DoA (Delegation of Authority), procurement governance policies, and internal control frameworks. • Support statutory, internal, and lender audits including project financing due diligence documentation. H. Project Coordination & Logistics • Coordinate with Project Management, Civil & Electrical Engineering, O&M, and Grid Connectivity teams for integrated material planning and delivery schedules. • Manage ODC/OWC (Over Dimensional Consignment / Overweight Consignment) transport for large EHV transformers, WTG nacelles, blades, and tower sections. • Oversee customs clearance for imported equipment, freight management, and last-mile delivery to remote wind/solar sites. • Maintain a critical path procurement tracker and proactively manage supply chain risks to avoid project delays. I. Reporting & Analytics • Deliver procurement MIS dashboards to senior leadership: spend analytics, savings achieved, vendor KPIs, delivery performance, and USS/GSS/PSS equipment status. Qualifications & Experience Educational Qualifications • B.E./B.Tech in Electrical Engineering — mandatory (essential for EHV and wind substation domains). • M.E./M.Tech in Power Systems or MBA in Supply Chain / Operations / Finance — preferred. • Certification in Supply Chain Management (CPSM, CIPS) or Project Management (PMP) is an added advantage. Work Experience • 10–12 years of progressive experience in procurement, sourcing, or supply chain management in the power or renewable energy sector. • Minimum 4–5 years in solar energy procurement (modules, inverters, BoP, SCADA, mounting systems). • Minimum 3–4 years in wind energy procurement with specific exposure to USS, GSS, and PSS substation equipment and 2-pole / 4-pole structural systems. • Minimum 3 years in EHV infrastructure procurement (132 kV and above) — substations, transmission lines, GIS/AIS switchgear, protection systems. • Prior experience managing procurement budgets of INR 150 Cr+ per annum across multi-technology renewable energy projects. • Hands-on experience with PGCIL/STU connectivity procedures, SECI/NTPC EPC contracts, and state DISCOM coordination.

review_candidates.title: Director Consulting Services - Rail Infra
review_candidates.description: Functiebeschrijving (Note: This job posting is only open to native level or near-native level Dutch speakers . If you are not proficient in Dutch, please have a look at our other job postings instead!) Spreek jij native of near-native Nederlands? Lees dan verder! Wil jij bijdragen aan de digitale transformatie van de spoorsector en zo meebouwen aan de toekomst van duurzame mobiliteit? De spoorwegen staan voor grote uitdagingen: de groeiende vraag naar capaciteit en de behoefte aan innovatieve, slimme oplossingen vereisen verdere digitalisering en modernisering van businessprocessen en IT-oplossingen. We bieden jou de kans om deel uit te maken van deze transformatie, waarbij continue innovatie en ontwikkeling centraal staan. Doe jij mee? Jouw rol in ons team Als Director ben jij de drijvende kracht achter de verdere groei van onze Rail Unit. In nauwe samenwerking met je collega Directors en leidinggevende in ons managementteam, bouw je aan sterke klantrelaties en werk je aan baanbrekende, innovatieve oplossingen voor de railsector om onze positie in de markt verder te ontwikkelen en te versterken. Je krijgt veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid om onze diensten te verbeteren en te vernieuwen. Je richt je op het waarborgen van uitstekende klanttevredenheid, het behalen van commerciële doelstellingen en het creëren van een cultuur waarin je team optimaal presteert en continu blijft groeien. Je stelt zelf je team samen en bepaalt hoe dit groeit, van jonge talentvolle mensen tot ervaren professionals. Om verbonden te blijven met je klant, je team en de markt, ben je zelf voor ongeveer de helft van je tijd ingezet binnen projecten. Flexibiliteit in werkplek en werkinvulling is mogelijk, afhankelijk van de behoeften van onze klanten. Onze grootste klant, de beheerder van de Nederlandse Railinfrastructuur, staat voor de uitdaging om innovatieve oplossingen te realiseren en zo aan de snel toenemende vraag naar spoorcapaciteit te voldoen. Uitbouwen van het spoorwegnet is slechts beperkt mogelijk. Het moet daarom slimmer en sneller, waardoor vernieuwing van het IT landschap essentieel is. Je helpt onze klant daarom met de automatisering van business processen en de verdere modernisering van het IT-landschap. Je draagt daarmee bij aan het realiseren van haar uitdagende ambities, zoals De implementatie van het nieuwe Europese beveiligingssysteem ERTMS; Slimmere planning en uitvoering van de dienstregeling; Het verhogen van de beschikbaarheid en efficiëntie van het spoor. Hoe jij ons team versterkt Je hebt ervaring met: Business development, sales en delivery binnen complexe technische of infrastructuuromgevingen; Het leiden en coachen van teams van 10-15 medewerkers; Contract- en financieelmanagement; De railsector of vergelijkbare technische domeinen, zoals mobiliteit of logistiek. Je bent: Ondernemend, proactief en resultaatgericht; Een teamspeler die anderen inspireert en weet te overtuigen van ideeën; In staat om samen met je team complexe klantvragen om te zetten in innovatieve en toekomstgerichte oplossingen. Je beschikt over: Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden in het Nederlands en Engels, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk. Een afgeronde HBO/WO opleiding. Een pre-employment screening maakt onderdeel uit van de sollicitatieprocedure Waarom CGI CGI is één van 's werelds grootste IT-consultancy bedrijven. Onze mensen houden Nederland draaiende. Overheidsinstellingen, banken, lucht- en ruimtevaart, infrastructurele organisaties en energie- en productiebedrijven zijn klanten van CGI. We werken aan interessante projecten die het alledaagse leven van miljoenen mensen raken. We zijn regionaal aanwezig, versterkt met wereldwijde domeinkennis, ons ecosysteem en collega's verspreid over de hele wereld. We zijn trots op de impactvolle projecten die we samen met onze collega’s tot een succes maken. Bij CGI hechten we veel waarde aan diversiteit, inclusie en gelijkwaardigheid, omdat dit niet alleen de samenwerking bevordert, maar ook leidt tot betere resultaten. We voeren actief beleid om mensen met een afstand tot de arbeidsmarkt een plek te geven in onze unit. We kijken uit naar jouw bijdrage aan ons team! We werken bij CGI in kleine zelfsturende teams bestaande uit experts in je vakgebied. De regie over je eigen carrière met daarbij de ruimte om jezelf te blijven ontwikkelen. Je werkt met de nieuwste technologieën. Een uitstekend salaris en aantrekkelijke secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden Direct een vast contract Parttime mogelijkheden De mogelijkheid om CGI aandeelhouder te worden CGI Rail, gevestigd in Rotterdam werkt aan de transformatie van railsystemen die essentieel zijn voor de besturing van het Nederlandse spoorwegnet. Je komt te werken in onze gezellige RainInfra Unit binnen de sector Rail en Public Transport. Daarin speel je een cruciale rol in de uitdaging om verouderde IT-systemen in de spoorwegsector te vernieuwen en nieuwe systemen toe te voegen. Deze systemen zijn verantwoordelijk voor de aansturing van seinen en wissels en het leveren van informatie aan treindienstleiders en andere afnemers, zoals treinposities en wisselstanden. Daarnaast ontwikkelen wij voor de spoorsector en onze klant simulatiesystemen voor het opleiden van treindienstleiders en het testen van praktijkveranderingen met 3D visualisaties voor machinisten. Sluit je aan bij ons team van experts en solliciteer direct! Meer informatie over de inhoud van de vacature? Neem contact op met Vice President Consulting Services, Gert Jan Spierenburg gertjan.spierenburg@cgi.com. Vragen over de sollicitatieprocedure? Neem contact op met Recruitment business partner Natrah Pula via 06 11218723 of via Natrah.pula@cgi.com. Wij werken niet samen met externe recruitment-partijen. Acquisitie naar aanleiding van onze vacatures wordt daarom niet op prijs gesteld! Taken en verantwoordelijkheden Criteria Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action. In 1976 opgericht als een familiebedrijf, is CGI vandaag de dag een van de grootste onafhankelijke zakelijke en ICT-dienstverleners ter wereld. Bij ons draait het om ownership, teamwork en respect. Je krijgt de ruimte om al je talenten volledig te ontplooien. Vanaf je eerste werkdag ben je mede-eigenaar van CGI. We profiteren samen van ons succes en je krijgt de kans én verantwoordelijkheid om actief bij te dragen aan de koers en strategie van ons bedrijf. Jouw inzet voegt waarde toe. Je werkt aan innovatieve oplossingen en bouwt aan je netwerk van collega's en klanten. Je hebt toegang tot wereldwijde kansen om je ideeën te realiseren, mogelijkheden te benutten en te profiteren van onze kennis van de industrie en technologische expertise. Ontdek bij ons de mogelijkheden voor jouw persoonlijke ontwikkeling en zet de volgende stap in je carrière. Hier staat jouw succes centraal!

review_candidates.title: Project Development and Reporting Officer (P)
review_candidates.description: Job Description Introduction Established in 1951, IOM is a Related Organization of the United Nations and the leading UN agency in the field of migration. Working closely with governmental, intergovernmental and non-governmental partners, IOM promotes humane and orderly migration for the benefit of all. It saves lives and protects people on the move, drives solutions to displacement, and facilitates pathways for regular migration, while providing services and advice to governments and migrants. IOM is committed to fostering a respectful, inclusive and supportive workplace where all employees can thrive professionally and feel valued. By creating such an environment, IOM aims to better harness the full potential of migration and strengthen its support to people on the move. IOM invites candidates from diverse backgrounds to apply and provides reasonable accommodation throughout the recruitment process when required. Learn more about IOM’s workplace culture at IOM workplace culture | International Organization for Migration. Applications are welcome from first- and second-tier candidates, particularly qualified female candidates as well as applications from the non-represented member countries of IOM. For all IOM vacancies, applications from qualified and eligible first-tier candidates are considered before those of qualified and eligible second-tier candidates in the selection process. For the purpose of this vacancy, the following are considered first-tier candidates: Internal candidates Candidates from the following IOM Member States that are not represented among staff members in the Professional and higher categories: Bahamas, Barbados, Cabo Verde, Comoros, Congo (the), Cook Islands, Dominica, Federated States of Micronesia, Grenada, Guinea-Bissau, Holy See, Iceland, Israel, Kiribati, Marshall Islands, Namibia, Nauru, Palau, Saint Kitts and Nevis, Saint Lucia, Samoa, Sao Tome and Principe, Seychelles, Solomon Islands, Suriname, Timor-Leste, Tonga, Trinidad and Tobago, Tuvalu, Vanuatu Second Tier Candidates Include All external candidates, except candidates from non-represented member states of IOM. Organizational Context and Scope Under the overall supervision of the Chief of Mission (COM) and direct supervision of the PSU Coordinator, and in close collaboration with the Deputy Chief of Mission (DCOM) and relevant units at the Regional Office and Headquarters (HQ), the Project Development and Reporting Officer will be responsible and accountable for supporting the coordination and facilitation of project development, donor and institutional reporting in the fields of migration management, emergency response, as well as assisting with liaison activities with counterparts in the government, UN agencies and other relevant stakeholders in line with IOM’s regional and country strategies. Responsibilities Contribute to the development of results-based programmes and projects, concept notes and project proposals, in close coordination with the DCOM, PSU Coordinator, Project Managers, UNCT, relevant donors, government counterparts and project partners, by providing technical inputs and support that respond to emerging trends and priorities and that are in compliance with IOM and donor interests and requirements. Review resource requirements, document programmatic needs, gaps and opportunities. Contribute to the alignment with IOM global, regional and country strategies during project development and donor reporting, including supporting and promoting the use of the Strategic Results Framework (SRF) global results and indicators. Support the endorsement process for concept notes and project proposals. Support the Project Managers in drafting donor reports in close coordination with relevant units in the CO and RO in line with IOM policies, standards and internal procedures. Research potential and realistic funding opportunities among government and non-government donors, review calls for proposals and collect donor information. Draft donor profiles and guidance notes on donor priorities, and assist with developing approaches to expand the IOM donor base. Support effective working relationships with donor counterparts and project/programme partners, such as government authorities, diplomatic missions, and other relevant agencies and working groups. In coordination with relevant Units in the CO, draft visibility and other resource mobilization materials and organize donor briefings and visits. Capacity building and training activities in the field of programme development, donor and institutional reporting, and the roll-out of the SRF for CO’s staff through workshops and seminars. In support of knowledge management, maintain accurate, updated, and pertinent records of all correspondence, project development, and donor and institutional reporting files, and related information in IOM’s relevant software application. Perform such other duties as may be assigned. Qualifications Required Qualifications and Experience Education Master’s degree in International Relations, International Development, Political or Social Sciences, Migration Studies, Law, or a related field from an accredited academic institution with two years of relevant professional experience; or, University degree in the above fields with four years of relevant professional experience . Accredited Universities are those listed in the UNESCO World Higher Education Database. Experience Experience in supporting results-based project development and reporting, technical writing and editing, preferably in the international development/humanitarian sector; and, Work experience in donor relations and grant management for specific donors of IOM’s interest. Skills Good communication, writing and organizational skills; ability to prepare clear and concise reports; Basic knowledge of monitoring and evaluation concepts, approaches and methodologies; Confirmed experience in donor report writing in humanitarian and/or development settings; Experience with Results-Based Management approach and other strategic planning approaches; Strong analytical and planning skills; capacity to establish working relationships with governmental authorities, national and international institutions and Non-Governmental Organizations; Capacity to supervise and train support staff; ability to work effectively and harmoniously with colleagues from varied cultures and professional backgrounds; Ability to work with accuracy under constraints and pressure; high sense of confidentiality, initiative and good judgment; Personal commitment, efficiency, flexibility, drive for results, creative thinking; and, Good level of computer literacy, including database applications. Languages For this position, fluency in English is required (oral and written). Working knowledge of another official UN languages (Arabic, Chinese, French, Russian, and Spanish) is an advantage. Proficiency of language(s) required will be specifically evaluated during the selection process, which may include written and/or oral assessments. Required Competencies IOM’s competency framework can be found at this link . Competencies will be assessed during the selection process. Values - all IOM staff members must abide by and demonstrate these five values: Inclusion and respect for diversity: Respects and promotes individual and cultural differences. Encourages diversity and inclusion. Integrity and transparency: Maintains high ethical standards and acts in a manner consistent with organizational principles/rules and standards of conduct. Professionalism: Demonstrates ability to work in a composed, competent and committed manner and exercises careful judgment in meeting day-to-day challenges. Courage: Demonstrates willingness to take a stand on issues of importance. Empathy: Shows compassion for others, makes people feel safe, respected and fairly treated. Core Competencies – behavioural indicators Level 2 Teamwork: Develops and promotes effective collaboration within and across units to achieve shared goals and optimize results. Delivering results: Produces and delivers quality results in a service-oriented and timely manner. Is action-oriented and committed to achieving agreed outcomes. Managing and sharing knowledge: Continuously seeks to learn, share knowledge and innovate. Accountability: Takes ownership for achieving the Organization’s priorities and assumes responsibility for own actions and delegated work. Communication: Encourages and contributes to clear and open communication. Explains complex matters in an informative, inspiring and motivational way. Managerial Competencies – behavioural indicators Level 2 Leadership: Provides a clear sense of direction, leads by example and demonstrates the ability to carry out the Organization’s vision. Assists others to realize and develop their leadership and professional potential. Empowering others: Creates an enabling environment where staff can contribute their best and develop their potential. Building Trust: Promotes shared values and creates an atmosphere of trust and honesty. Strategic thinking and vision: Works strategically to realize the Organization’s goals and communicates a clear strategic direction. Humility: Leads with humility and shows openness to acknowledging own shortcomings. Notes Internationally recruited professional staff are required to be mobile. Please refer to this link for guidance on IOM Job Category. Any offer made to the candidate in relation to this vacancy notice is subject to funding confirmation. This selection process may be used to staff similar positions in various duty stations. Recommended candidates will remain eligible to be appointed in a similar position for a period of 24 months. Appointment will be subject to all clearances, including medical and security, as well as accreditation, and any residency or visa requirements. Vacancies close at 23:59 local time in Geneva, Switzerland on the respective closing date. No late applications will be accepted. IOM has a zero-tolerance policy on conduct that is incompatible with the aims and objectives of the United Nations and IOM, including sexual exploitation and abuse, harassment, sexual harassment, abuse of authority and any forms of discrimination. IOM is committed to promote the protection and safeguarding of all children. IOM conducts reference checks and background verification, including through system-wide databases such as ClearCheck, to help ensure that candidates have no record of misconduct, including on sexual harassment, sexual exploitation and abuse, or fraud. Candidates are expected to uphold these standards and principles at all times. IOM does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process—whether for application, interview, processing, training, or otherwise—and does not request any information related to bank accounts. IOM only accepts duly completed applications submitted through the IOM WAVE system (for internal candidates, link here ). The online tool also allows candidates to track the status of their application. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. For further information and other job postings, you are welcome to visit our website: IOM Careers and Job Vacancies .

Basic Requirements 8+ years of experience in a CSM or account management role at a software/SaaS/Cloud products company serving Enterprise clients Experience managing the entire renewal cycle — client engagement, value proposition, negotiation, managing paper process, and closing deals worth $100K+ Fluent English, with strong verbal and written proficiency Experience using AI tools in a professional setting Must be able to work during U.S. business hours Nice-to-have Requirements Track record renewing complex, high-value B2B software (SaaS and on-prem) and related services with large enterprises Experience selling multiple products across different verticals or business units Comfort selling value-added services and premium tiers on business benefit rather than price Hands-on use of ChatGPT or Claude to raise the quality and throughput of customer-facing work About Trilogy Hundreds of software businesses run on the Trilogy Business Platform. You'll collaborate closely with stakeholders, steering your team through the development journey and overseeing releases. Your role involves working closely with stakeholders, helping transform innovative ideas into customer-ready features while nurturing and guiding your team's growth.   You'll take charge of executing the roadmap at the pod level , ensuring your team delivers according to plan – with your team leveraging AI coding assistants and agentic workflows as a core part of how work gets done.  ✨ WHAT YOUR MAIN FOCUS WILL BE: 1. People & Delivery Leadership • Lead, guide and inspire a pod of skilled engineers, fostering collaboration and a customer-centric mindset. • Set clear goals, expectations, and delivery standards for the pod. • Monitor pod progress, provide timely updates, and proactively escalate risks to keep projects on track. • Coach team members on both engineering craft and effective use of AI-assisted development tools. 2. Execution & AI-Driven Delivery • Execute the engineering roadmap at the pod level by translating release plans into actionable tasks while overseeing the timely delivery of high-quality solutions. • Champion the adoption of AI coding assistants and agentic development workflows within the pod to improve delivery speed and code quality. • Facilitate the connection between development, QA, and product feedback to ensure continuous improvement and alignment. 3. Technical Contribution & Quality • Engage in coding best practices through peer reviews and adherence to engineering standards, including standards for responsible and effective AI-assisted coding. • Contribute hands-on where needed to unblock the team on complex problems. • Help ensure output from AI coding assistants meets the team's quality, security, and architectural standards before it ships. 4. Stakeholder Collaboration • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand customer personas and pain points, translating insights into actionable software features while ensuring engineering delivery aligns with business objectives and market demands across the organization. • Ensure clear communication and strong ownership across teams. 5. Continuous Learning & Team Growth • Foster a culture of continuous learning and improvement, encouraging team members to enhance their skills and adopt best practices. • Stay current on emerging AI tools and agentic development practices, and bring relevant ones into the team's workflow. 🌟 WHAT YOU BRING : ✅ Educational Background: Bachelor of Information Technology, or relevant field. ✅ Technical Expertise (Core Requirement) • 7+ years of software development experience (preferably in B2B SaaS or field service platforms) • At least 3 years of experience in a leadership role , guiding teams to deliver impactful solutions • Strong product mindset focused on customer value and business outcomes, with experience in UAT, go-to-market strategies, and client onboarding • Ability to balance hands-on coding with leadership, fostering collaboration within cross-functional teams ✅ AI & Agentic AI Expertise (Must-have)  • Hands-on, day-to-day experience using AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or equivalent) across the development lifecycle – from planning and coding to testing and review. • Practical experience with Agentic AI : directing autonomous or semi-autonomous coding agents, structuring tasks for them, and validating/reviewing their output for correctness, security, and maintainability. • Solid understanding of Large Language Models (LLMs) and prompt engineering, and how to apply them within AI-Driven Software Development Lifecycles (AIDLC). • Ability to set and enforce team-level standards for AI-assisted coding — code review of AI-generated code, security review, and avoiding over-reliance on ungrounded AI output. • Comfortable coaching engineers at different skill levels on how to work effectively and responsibly with AI coding tools. ✅ Leadership & Mindset • Strong communication, problem-solving, and collaboration skills • Ability to influence engineers without micromanaging • Passion for building high-quality, AI-augmented engineering teams • Comfortable balancing technical depth with day-to-day delivery pressure ✅ Communication & Stakeholder Management • Proficient in English (verbal and written) • Experience working with global teams (UK is a plus) • Ability to translate business needs into technical direction (*) Nice-to-have Points: • Experience collaborating with UK-based customers. • Understanding of field service management processes and agile delivery cycles • Knowledge of containerization technologies. • Proficient coding skills in relevant technologies (e.g., C#, .NET, Angular, SQL, or a similar stack used at Joblogic). • A passion for leveraging technology to tackle real-world problems and enhance operational trust across various industries. 🌟 OUR HIRING JOURNEY: We believe every hiring journey should be a great experience! That's why we've designed our process to be clear, efficient, and respectful of your time. Here's what you can expect at Joblogic:  ✅ Step 1 | Online Assessment (~30 mins)   Complete a Cognitive & Personality Assessment to help us better understand your problem-solving approach, thinking style, and workplace preferences.  ✅ Step 2 | Hiring Manager Review  Our Hiring Manager will review your experience. Qualified candidates will be shortlisted and moved directly to the final interview stage.   ✅ Step 3 | Onsite Panel Interview (~2 hours, conducted in English) Shortlisted candidates will be invited onsite for a panel discussion and interactive Q&A session with our VN Management Team. This session allows us to explore your thought process, technical leadership, delivery approach, AI-driven practices, communication skills, problem-solving approach, and overall fit for the role. 🌟 WHY YOU WILL LOVE WORKING AT JOBLOGIC: Take Ownership. Drive Impact: Join a fast-growing international SaaS company where you'll take ownership of product features and deliver real value to customers. Grow with Us: Learn from talented teammates, embrace new challenges, and accelerate your career.  Innovate Every Day : Work with the latest technologies and AI-driven development practices to solve complex, meaningful problems every day. 🌟 REMUNERATION PACKAGE AND BENEFITS: 🏢 UK-based product environment with real ownership and impact 💰 Competitive compensation package (including 100% Gross during Probation , 13th-month salary , loyalty bonus…) 🤖 AI-first direction aligned with the AIDLC model – access to a Claude Code account and opportunities to explore and apply AI / Agentic AI across development, testing, automation, and day-to-day engineering workflows 💻 Working devices provided (laptop & necessary equipment for the role) 📚 Premium healthcare & full Social Insurance coverage 🌴 15+ days of paid leave per year 🏠 Enjoy one WFH day every 4 months 🎓 Ongoing learning and development opportunities , supported by internal training, workshops and certification sponsorship 🤗 Plus plenty of extras : company trip, team-building activities, sports clubs, special occasion gifts, and more. 🌟 HOW TO APPLY? 📩 Send your CV to email: hah@joblogic.com to take the next step and be part of an exciting journey that’s shaping the future of our field service software 🤗 If you’re excited about AI-driven innovation, enjoy solving meaningful challenges, and thrive alongside talented people in a fast-moving and customer-first environment, JOBLOGIC is the place to be!

new_matches.title: Information and Communications Technology (ICT) Officer (P)
new_matches.description: Job Description Introduction Established in 1951, IOM is a Related Organization of the United Nations and the leading UN agency in the field of migration. Working closely with governmental, intergovernmental, and non-governmental partners, IOM promotes humane and orderly migration for the benefit of all. It saves lives and protects people on the move, drives solutions to displacement, and facilitates pathways for regular migration, while providing services and advice to governments and migrants. IOM is committed to fostering a respectful, inclusive, and supportive workplace where all employees can thrive professionally and feel valued. By creating such an environment, IOM aims to better harness the full potential of migration and strengthen its support to people on the move. IOM invites candidates from diverse backgrounds to apply and provides reasonable accommodation throughout the recruitment process when required. Learn more about IOM’s workplace culture at IOM workplace culture | International Organization for Migration . Applications are welcome from first- and second-tier candidates, particularly qualified female candidates as well as applications from the non-represented member countries of IOM. For all IOM vacancies, applications from qualified and eligible first-tier candidates are considered before those of qualified and eligible second-tier candidates in the selection process. For the purpose of this vacancy, the following are considered first-tier candidates: Internal candidates Candidates from the following IOM Member States that are not represented among staff members in the Professional and higher categories: Bahamas, Barbados, Cabo Verde, Comoros, Congo (the), Cook Islands, Dominica, Federated States of Micronesia, Grenada, Guinea-Bissau, Holy See, Iceland, Israel, Kiribati, Marshall Islands, Namibia, Nauru, Palau, Saint Kitts and Nevis, Saint Lucia, Samoa, Sao Tome and Principe, Seychelles, Solomon Islands, Suriname, Timor-Leste, Tonga, Trinidad and Tobago, Tuvalu, Vanuatu Second Tier Candidates Include All external candidates, except candidates from non-represented member states of IOM. Organizational Context and Scope Under the overall supervision of Chief of Mission (CoM), direct supervision of the Head of Resources Management and in close coordination with relevant staff from ICT department counterparts in the Regional Officer Asia and Pacific (ROAP) and the Department of Information and Communications Technology at HQ, the Information and Communication Technology (ICT) Officer will supervise and coordinate the ICT operations in the Country Office (CO) including its Sub-Offices. Responsibilities Supervise and coordinate the activities of the Information and Communications Technology (ICT) Unit in the Country Office by ensuring that all requirements are addressed in a timely and accurately, with an efficient allocation of resources, and that all operations are in compliance with IOM ICT policies and standards and are in line with the ICT strategy. Coordinate the continuous engagement and liaison with the CO’s management, Heads of units and field operations, for the adequate and timely provision of ICT solutions and services to satisfy operational needs, including emergencies as necessary. Act as the ICT business relationship and cybersecurity local liaison Focal Point with counterparts such as IOM programmes, global cybersecurity programme, Governmental, donors, United Nations Agencies, Non-Governmental Organizations (NGOs), ICT service providers, and Vendors for coordinated and adequate provision of ICT services, digital innovation, technologies and supplies. Participate in the ICT Working Group in the country, representing the CO in discussions and initiatives. Provide technical support for the CO’s ICT services and supervise, train, and equip the CO’s ICT Team to effectively implement strategic initiatives, timely respond to information security incidents, and provide Tier 1 support and escalate to the relevant specialist teams/units, when needed, for immediate corrective/remedial actions. Contribute to the preparation of the CO’s ICT documentation including office-specific Standard Operating Procedures (SOP), Business Continuity Plan, Disaster Recovery Plans and ICT Risk record for the CO’s ICT-related services. Coordinate and monitor the delivery and efficiency of services and redundancy in line with IOM ICT standards while checking that global ICT SOPs are complied with. Contribute to the service improvement assessments and provide recommendations to the CO’s management to optimize and implement ICT Infrastructure and solutions to ensure the efficient functioning of CO’s operations. Maintain and check that all technical specifications for procurement and provision of ICT-related equipment, supplies, services, and technical evaluations are in line with ICT standards and policies, and are adequately managed. Liaise with CO’s Supply Chain Unit to guide on proper provision of ICT-related equipment, supplies, services, and propose the most suitable solutions. In coordination with the ICT Information Security Unit at HQ, act as the Focal Point, the first line of cybersecurity defense, and first local cybersecurity incident responder in the CO. Facilitate the implementation of security and compliance controls of the IOM global cybersecurity programme and compliance with the IOM global cybersecurity, and other compliances required by the donors, operational frameworks and standards. Perform such other duties as may be assigned. Qualifications Required Qualifications and Experience Education Master’s degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Information Management, Information Technology, or a related field from an accredited academic institution with two years of relevant professional experience; or, University degree in the above fields with four years of relevant professional experience. Certificate in any of the following: Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA), Microsoft Azure certifications, Microsoft Certified System Administrator (MCSA), Microsoft Certified Database Administrator (MCDBA), Microsoft Certified System Engineer (MCSE) is a distinct advantage. Accredited Universities are those listed in the UNESCO World Higher Education Database. Experience Experience in overseeing and managing the implementation and administration of Microsoft Windows and serverless network environments (LAN/WAN) and first-level network/desktop support in a large international organization is required; Experience in a supervisory role and management of ICT functions in an international organization or an international agency in a field location; supporting emergency, complex/post-conflict Country Office; Experience in planning, design, development, implementation, and maintenance of computer information systems; Knowledge and demonstrated experience in cybersecurity compliance and security implementation and maintenance, database information systems, and data processing tools. Knowledge of web-based development and other development tools and reporting, including future projections on the potential of current and new technologies; Good knowledge and experience in Microsoft 365 cloud-based applications and technologies; and, Experience providing policy advice to senior managers on systems development in a changing business environment and the implications of various alternatives, on business applications planned for future needs and other related issues. Skills Good oral and written communication skills; refined soft skills and demonstrated ability to communicate with business leaders and those with limited technical background effectively is essential; Good knowledge of Windows Operating System, Network\Systems administration, TCP/IP, Telecoms, Network Protocols, Cisco devices, VPN, VoIP, MS Office 365 apps, Antivirus Software, and utilities; Good knowledge of web-based development, geographical information systems, and/or mapping tools would be a distinctive advantage; Demonstrated ability to work with minimal supervision and demonstrate a high level of initiative, perseverance, and professional commitment to achieve high-quality results; Demonstrated ability to handle confidential data in a professional, responsible, and mature manner; and, Demonstrated ability to train individuals, to work effectively and harmoniously with colleagues within a team from varied cultures and professional backgrounds. Languages For this position, fluency in English is required (oral and written). Working knowledge of another official UN languages (Arabic, Chinese, French, Russian, and Spanish) is an advantage. Proficiency of language(s) required will be specifically evaluated during the selection process, which may include written and/or oral assessments. Required Competencies IOM’s competency framework can be found at this link . Competencies will be assessed during the selection process. Values - all IOM staff members must abide by and demonstrate these five values: Inclusion and respect for diversity: Respects and promotes individual and cultural differences. Encourages diversity and inclusion. Integrity and transparency: Maintains high ethical standards and acts in a manner consistent with organizational principles/rules and standards of conduct. Professionalism: Demonstrates ability to work in a composed, competent and committed manner and exercises careful judgment in meeting day-to-day challenges. Courage: Demonstrates willingness to take a stand on issues of importance. Empathy: Shows compassion for others, makes people feel safe, respected and fairly treated. Core Competencies – behavioural indicators Level 2 Teamwork: Develops and promotes effective collaboration within and across units to achieve shared goals and optimize results. Delivering results: Produces and delivers quality results in a service-oriented and timely manner. Is action-oriented and committed to achieving agreed outcomes. Managing and sharing knowledge: Continuously seeks to learn, share knowledge and innovate. Accountability: Takes ownership for achieving the Organization’s priorities and assumes responsibility for own actions and delegated work. Communication: Encourages and contributes to clear and open communication. Explains complex matters in an informative, inspiring and motivational way. Managerial Competencies – behavioural indicators Level 2 Leadership: Provides a clear sense of direction, leads by example and demonstrates the ability to carry out the Organization’s vision. Assists others to realize and develop their leadership and professional potential. Empowering others: Creates an enabling environment where staff can contribute their best and develop their potential. Building Trust: Promotes shared values and creates an atmosphere of trust and honesty. Strategic thinking and vision: Works strategically to realize the Organization’s goals and communicates a clear strategic direction. Humility: Leads with humility and shows openness to acknowledging own shortcomings. Notes Internationally recruited professional staff are required to be mobile. Please refer to this link for guidance on IOM Job Category. Any offer made to the candidate in relation to this vacancy notice is subject to funding confirmation. This selection process may be used to staff similar positions in various duty stations. Recommended candidates will remain eligible to be appointed in a similar position for a period of 24 months. Appointment will be subject to all clearances, including medical and security, as well as accreditation, and any residency or visa requirements. Vacancies close at 23:59 local time in Geneva, Switzerland on the respective closing date. No late applications will be accepted. IOM has a zero-tolerance policy on conduct that is incompatible with the aims and objectives of the United Nations and IOM, including sexual exploitation and abuse, harassment, sexual harassment, abuse of authority and any forms of discrimination. IOM is committed to promote the protection and safeguarding of all children. IOM conducts reference checks and background verification, including through system-wide databases such as ClearCheck, to help ensure that candidates have no record of misconduct, including on sexual harassment, sexual exploitation and abuse, or fraud. Candidates are expected to uphold these standards and principles at all times. IOM does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process—whether for application, interview, processing, training, or otherwise—and does not request any information related to bank accounts. IOM only accepts duly completed applications submitted through the IOM WAVE system (for internal candidates, link here ). The online tool also allows candidates to track the status of their application. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. For further information and other job postings, you are welcome to visit our website: IOM Careers and Job Vacancies.
