new_matches.title: 2nd Line Delivery Professional
new_matches.description: Job Title: 2nd Line Delivery Professional Req ID: 58424 Job Function: Service Posting Start Date: 01/09/2026 Posting End Date: 08/09/2026 Division: UK Business Job Location: GBR Glasgow - Alexndr Bain Hse, GBR Sheffield Endeavour, GBR-Birmingham-Three Snowhill, GBR-London-BTHQ One Braham, GBR-Manchester-New Bailey Advertised Salary: Competitive Job Req ID: 58424 Posting Date: 13/08/2026 Function: Service Location: London, Sheffield, Birmingham, Manchester or Glasgow Salary: Competitive Note: There is a requirement to work a shift team pattern to cover customer deliveries (after training). Whilst the role is largely undertaken during the normal working business day there is a requirement to cover late shifts and Saturday working to meet customer and business demands. About The Role This role provides technical service delivery to our customers through the use of Data Services technologies. By using market leading products and applying BTs process, quality and intellectual property, we provide our customers with services to facilitate their objectives through the power of communication. The role requires a skilled technical engineer who is an innovative, engaging, driven individual and has a proven record of achievement. Please note you must either hold or be eligible for SC (Security Clearance), BPSS & NPPV 3 Clearance for this role, which will require a minimum of 5 years working history in the UK to be eligible. What You’ll Be Doing Utilising experience and evolving technical ability to resolve technical delivery incidents, changes or problems relating to connectivity solutions for dedicated internet access and IP VPN. Progressing service delivery requests in line with agreed processes and procedures on both customer and provider edge routers and devices. Working effectively with the customer and/or their representatives, and other parts of BT during production, delivery & development. Providing remote support to onsite engineers during solution deployment and resolving issues. Actively supporting and implementing efficient ways of working and cost reduction. Essential Skills / Experience Hands-on experience delivering Data Services technologies, including LAN/WAN, Cisco and Cisco Meraki solutions, with proven ability to configure, commission and support Cisco routers and related network services. CCNA certified (or equivalent networking qualification) with practical experience across routing, switching, VLANs, WAN, LAN, Wi-Fi, BGP, HSRP, IP addressing, diagnostics, troubleshooting and PE/CE router configuration in a delivery environment. Proven ability to take ownership of technical deliveries, incidents and changes through to resolution, supported by strong organisational, prioritisation, communication and problem-solving skills while managing competing priorities and maintaining customer focus. Desirable Skills/experience CCNP certification, working towards CCNP, or progressing towards another equivalent advanced vendor networking certification. Experience supporting complex technical deliveries involving PE/CE router configuration, commissioning, troubleshooting or service-impacting change activity. Experience working across multiple stakeholders to resolve technical blockers, manage escalations and driving delivery issues through to completion. Our Package Tailored benefits make a real difference. That’s why we offer a comprehensive range to support your growth, wellbeing, and everyday life. You can design the package to suit you and your lifestyle. Your core benefits include: 10% on target annual bonus Access to an online private GP 24/7 for you and your immediate family Market-leading paid carers leave with up to 2 weeks off Equalized maternity, paternity, and adoption leave – 18 weeks’ full pay and 8 weeks’ half pay Discounted EE and BT products, including mobile and broadband Market leading Pension scheme – 5% from you and 10% from us Holiday purchase scheme You can select additional benefits, including healthcare, dental, gym memberships and more when you’re ready. BT Group is the UK’s leading communications group and the holding company behind some of the country’s most recognised brands – including BT, EE, Openreach and Plusnet. Our purpose is as simple as it is ambitious: we connect for good. Our customers include consumers, small, medium and large businesses, public sector organisations and other communications providers. BT Group’s role is about setting direction, unlocking value and creating the conditions for our brands and businesses to thrive. Having come through the most capital-intensive phase of our fibre investment, our focus now is on what comes next – simplifying how we operate, using technology and AI to work smarter, and organising ourselves to serve customers better and grow sustainably. Group teams shape strategy, policy, brand, capital allocation and transformation, helping the whole organisation perform at its best. We have a singular culture that unites all our people: we are customer-first challengers, who are committed, clear and connected. These behaviours unite us as one team to deliver for our colleagues, our customers, our stakeholders and the country. Joining BT Group means working at the heart of a business that matters to the UK, with the opportunity to shape decisions, influence outcomes and help set the future course of one of the country’s most important companies.

Backed by a legacy of engineering excellence, reliability and industry-leading customer service, Telesat has grown to be one of the largest and most successful global satellite operators. Telesat Lightspeed, our revolutionary Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite network, scheduled to begin service in 2027, will revolutionize global broadband connectivity for enterprise and Government users by delivering a combination of high capacity, security, resiliency and affordability with ultra-low latency and fiber-like speeds. Telesat is headquartered in Ottawa, Canada, and has offices and facilities around the world. The company’s state-of-the-art Satellite fleet consists of 12 GEO satellites, the Canadian payload on ViaSat-1 and one LEO 3 demonstration satellite. For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com Role Overview: As a member of the Global Customer Solutions (GCS) Group, you will provide technical support for the pre- and post-sales activities of Telesat’s product lines and technical consultation to the Global Sales groups. As a champion of new technology, you will develop effective solutions to meet customer communication needs leveraging Telesat’s Lightspeed constellation. The position’s primary role is to support the Asia-Pacific (APAC) region teams, but will also assist across Telesat’s global presence. The GCS team is responsible for the gathering of requirements from customers, design of cost-effective Lightspeed satellite and terrestrial communication link solutions, specifying both the space and ground segment components, and presenting solutions to customers. Additionally, you will be offering technology recommendations and advice, performing modeling and simulations, and conducting test and evaluation demonstrations aiming to secure sales and customer satisfaction. Key Responsibilities Design, estimate cost, and propose Lightspeed communications solutions based on customer requirements Work directly with the Global Sales Team and prospective customers’ Engineering contacts to validate requirements and technical details Prepare, present proposals to, and review requirements directly with customers Lead, attend, and actively participate in customer meetings Identify new solutions within Telesat’s Lightspeed product portfolio which could lead to new revenue opportunities with customers Work directly with customers to plan upgrades, review performance of networks, and to resolve service issues Collaborate with Telesat’s Marketing and Product teams to identify available network capacity Support projects from design to implementation Update and maintain multiple databases as well as other Engineering information management systems Actively participate in trade shows, customer events, and technical demonstrations in presentation roles Education & Experience Required: Bachelor degree or comparable experience in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Network Technology, Telecommunications, or Electrical Engineering required 10+ years of relevant experience in systems engineering or connectivity solutions Experience with satellite communications, RF link analysis, and RF hardware preferred Preferred Qualifications: Inquisitive nature and eagerness to learn and explore new concepts Positive outlook in meeting challenges and working to a high level Confident when presenting to peers and management within the organization Ability to manage multiple complex projects simultaneously Analytical skills with the ability to solve technical and business issues Ability to foster and maintain good working relationships with peers, partners, and customers Previous experience supporting Carrier, Mobile Network Operator (MNO), and Wholesale accounts. Working for a Carrier or an MNO would be desired A professional demeanor and appearance with strong verbal and written communication skills Proven analytical and problem-solving skills with demonstrated ability to multi-task and work in a team environment Industry certifications such as Cisco CCNA, CCNP, Juniper JNCIA/ENT preferable Experience and understanding of computer hardware, software, and operating systems Working knowledge of MEF 3.0 standards and implementations Working knowledge of: OSI Layer 1 (Optical, HFC, WDM) OSI Layer 2 & 3 (Switching, STP, VLAN, MPLS, Carrier Ethernet, IP, etc.) Protocol acceleration, web caching, traffic management, firewalls, VPN, and security related hardware and software 3G/4G/5G cellular networking technologies Network management platforms (SolarWinds, WhatsUp Gold, etc.) Other Requirements: Fluent English is required and a second language is highly desirable (written and/or spoken) Ability and willingness to travel to attend customer meetings and events across the region At Telesat, we take pride in being an equal opportunity employer that values equality in the workplace. We are committed to providing the best candidate experience possible including any required accommodations at every stage of our interview process. new_matches.description: IFS is a billion-dollar revenue company with 7000+ employees on all continents. Our leading AI technology is the backbone of our award-winning enterprise software solutions, enabling our customers to be their best when it really matters–at the Moment of Service™. Our commitment to internal AI adoption has allowed us to stay at the forefront of technological advancements, ensuring our colleagues can unlock their creativity and productivity, and our solutions are always cutting-edge. At IFS, we’re flexible, we’re innovative, and we’re focused not only on how we can engage with our customers but on how we can make a real change and have a worldwide impact. We help solve some of society’s greatest challenges, fostering a better future through our agility, collaboration, and trust. We celebrate diversity and understand our responsibility to reflect the diverse world we work in. We are committed to promoting an inclusive workforce that fully represents the many different cultures, backgrounds, and viewpoints of our customers, our partners, and our communities. As a truly international company serving people from around the globe, we realize that our success is tantamount to the respect we have for those different points of view. By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to be part of a global, diverse environment; you will be joining a winning team with a commitment to sustainability; and a company where we get things done so that you can make a positive impact on the world. We’re looking for innovative and original thinkers to work in an environment where you can #MakeYourMoment so that we can help others make theirs. With the power of our AI-driven solutions, we empower our team to change the status quo and make a real difference. If you want to change the status quo, we’ll help you make your moment. Join Team Purple. Join IFS. This role would require to travel also to the IFS office located in Netherlands, 1-2 a week depending on needs. Job Description IT Operations is the frontline connection between IT@IFS and our global user community, delivering local and remote support that ensures our colleagues have seamless access to the technology and systems they need to work efficiently. By providing responsive, high-quality support and continuously improving IT services, we enable teams to focus on delivering value without technical disruptions. This mid-level role is crafted for experienced IT professionals who excel in delivering high-quality technical support directly to end users across varied environments. As an IT Support Engineer, you are not only a frontline troubleshooter but also a strategic contributor to the broader support framework. You act as a critical escalation point for complex technical issues that go beyond first-line resolution, applying deep diagnostic expertise and a methodical approach to problem-solving. Your responsibilities span maintaining and enhancing the performance of end-user systems across a mixed Windows and macOS estate, managing device configurations, and leveraging AI-driven applications and workflow automation to streamline support and operational processes. In this capacity, you operate with a high degree of autonomy, often leading initiatives that improve service delivery and user satisfaction. You are expected to identify inefficiencies, implement system optimizations, and contribute to continual service improvement efforts. Collaboration is key, as you work closely with cross-functional and cross-regional teams to uphold service excellence, share best practices, and align support strategies with organizational goals. Your role also involves mentoring junior support staff, shaping technical documentation, and participating in the rollout of new technologies - including AI-driven applications and workflow automation tools - that enhance the end-user experience and operational efficiency. Ultimately, this position demands a balance of hands-on technical proficiency, strategic thinking, and a user-centric mindset. You are a trusted technical advisor within the support ecosystem, driving operational resilience and ensuring that users across the enterprise experience seamless, secure, and responsive IT services. Deliver Advanced Multi-Platform Support Provide expert-level technical assistance across Windows, macOS, and mobile platforms, with depth in macOS and the wider Apple ecosystem. Act as the go-to escalation resource for macOS - covering deployment, configuration, patching, security, and advanced troubleshooting of Apple hardware and software in an enterprise environment. Ensure seamless user experiences by resolving complex device, application, and connectivity issues both onsite and remotely. Lead Troubleshooting & Escalation Management Take ownership of persistent or high-impact technical problems, applying deep diagnostic expertise. Collaborate with infrastructure and application teams to escalate and resolve issues efficiently. Support & Optimize Office IT Infrastructure Maintain and enhance video conferencing systems, network connectivity, and shared office technologies. Ensure meeting spaces and collaboration tools are reliable, user-friendly, and aligned with hybrid work needs. Leverage AI-Driven Applications & Workflow Automation Apply AI-driven applications and support tools - such as AI assistants, copilots, and intelligent diagnostics - to accelerate triage, troubleshooting, and resolution. Design, build, and maintain workflow automations that streamline repetitive support tasks and operational processes, reducing manual effort and improving consistency. Identify opportunities to embed AI and automation into service delivery and champion their adoption across the support team. Ensure AI tools and automated workflows are used securely and responsibly, in line with IT governance and compliance standards. Represent IT in Cross-Functional Projects Act as a technical liaison in office expansions, infrastructure upgrades, and service transitions. Provide input on planning, implementation, and post-deployment support. Maintain Documentation & Knowledge Sharing Create and refine internal documentation, SOPs, and troubleshooting guides. Contribute to team knowledge bases and mentor peers through structured learning and informal coaching. Provide Regional Onsite Support Onsite, with occasional travel to regional offices, to deliver hands-on support, assist with deployments, and build relationships with local teams. Ensure consistent service standards across locations. Qualifications Education Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, or a related field (or equivalent experience). Certifications Apple certifications strongly preferred - ACSP (Apple Certified Support Professional) and ACiT (Apple Certified IT Professional). Other relevant certifications welcome (e.g., Microsoft Modern Desktop, ITIL Foundation). Experience Requirements Strong professional IT support experience, including remote and onsite roles. Deep, demonstrable macOS support experience in an enterprise environment — including macOS deployment, configuration, patching, security hardening, and advanced troubleshooting of Apple hardware and software. Hands-on experience managing Mac fleets with Jamf Pro, together with Apple Business Manager and the Apple Push Notification service; experience with Intune for cross-platform MDM. Advanced proficiency in Windows and mobile (iOS and Android) platforms. Hands-on experience with AI-driven applications - for example, AI assistants and copilots, chatbots, or AI-based support and diagnostic tools - to enhance productivity and service delivery. Practical experience with workflow automation tools (e.g., Microsoft Power Automate / Power Platform, ServiceNow workflows, or scripting such as PowerShell) to automate operational processes. Familiarity with ITIL service management and compliance practices. Experience supporting a global customer base and collaborating across time zones. Demonstrated professionalism, service mindset, and interpersonal skills. Proficient level of English language. Additional Information IFS is the fastest-growing international business software vendor. You will work with the leading Enterprise Software experts and have exposure to the latest technologies. You can expect an open corporate culture and a pleasant working atmosphere. Lean and effective collaboration and decision-making structures. You enjoy a high degree of personal responsibility and creative freedom in realizing your own ideas in a global environment. Attractive salary with above-average additional benefits. Car Allowance and additional compensation for business trips. Company pension plan. Further training opportunities and intensive support during the induction phase. Flexible working hours and mobile working models - Work from wherever you want, whether in the office or from home. Wellbeing-benefits: Jobrad & Wellpass 30 vacation days as well as additional special leave for birthdays and social commitment (CSR). If you are a results-oriented sales leader with a passion for driving business growth and fostering strong customer relationships, we invite you to apply for this exciting opportunity and join us shaping the future at the Moment of Service in the DACH market! Sounds exciting? Then we look forward to receiving your complete application through our online applicant management system in English language , stating your salary requirements and earliest possible starting date. We assure you explicit discretion and a comprehensive protection of your interests! We respectfully decline all offers of recruitment and/or advertising assistance.

Organised and methodical approach to handling tasks and routine activities. Highly developed customer facing and relationship management. Set and adhere to priorities and deadlines, and use time effectively to complete tasks, i.e. able to work under pressure. new_matches.title: Video Editor – Interviews & Human Stories
new_matches.description: We are looking for a talented and thoughtful Video Editor who is particularly strong at editing interviews, conversations, speeches, panels, podcasts, and people-focused content . This is a 100% remote position . While the vacancy is being advertised through LinkedIn in South Africa, you do not need to be based in South Africa to apply . We welcome qualified applicants from different countries and backgrounds. This position is not simply about cutting footage, adding subtitles, or making transitions. We are looking for an editor who can genuinely understand people . You should be able to watch a 30-minute or 60-minute interview and quickly identify: What is this person really trying to say? What is the most interesting idea in the conversation? Which sentence could become a strong short-form video? Where is the emotional or human moment? What makes this speaker different from everyone else? What will make an audience stop scrolling and listen? The right candidate should combine technical editing ability with storytelling, human insight, empathy, creativity, and strong communication skills . What You Will Be Editing Your work may include: One-on-one interviews Executive and founder interviews International conference interviews Speeches and keynote presentations Panel discussions Professional conversations Podcasts Thought-leadership videos Social-media short videos Event highlights Human-interest and documentary-style content A large part of the role involves working with content featuring people from different countries, cultures, industries, professions, and personal backgrounds . Key Responsibilities You will be responsible for: Reviewing long-form interview and event footage. Identifying the strongest ideas, quotes, emotional moments, and insights. Turning long conversations into engaging short-form videos. Editing polished long-form interviews and professional videos. Creating strong opening hooks within the first few seconds. Improving pacing and removing unnecessary or repetitive sections. Knowing when to use pauses rather than cutting too aggressively. Using facial expressions, reactions, and body language effectively. Adding professional subtitles and captions. Selecting suitable B-roll and supporting visuals. Using graphics, text animation, zooms, transitions, and visual emphasis when appropriate. Using music carefully without overpowering the speaker. Improving audio quality and maintaining consistent sound levels. Helping the personality of the interviewee come through naturally. Suggesting stronger story angles when you identify something interesting in the footage. Communicating with the team about creative ideas rather than simply waiting for detailed instructions. What We Are Looking For We are particularly interested in someone with: Strong video editing skills. Excellent storytelling instincts. Experience editing interviews or people-focused content. Strong understanding of human communication. Ability to recognize interesting ideas and meaningful statements. Good emotional awareness and empathy. Strong cross-cultural awareness. Ability to understand different accents and styles of communication. Strong English comprehension. Good written and verbal communication skills. Attention to detail. Good judgment about pacing and audience attention. Ability to work independently in a remote environment. Ability to receive feedback and improve quickly. Strong ownership of final video quality. Technical Skills Experience with one or more of the following is preferred: Adobe Premiere Pro DaVinci Resolve Final Cut Pro Adobe After Effects CapCut Descript AI-assisted video editing tools AI transcription and subtitle tools Audio enhancement tools Experience using AI to help with transcription, identifying highlights, content analysis, subtitles, B-roll research, or editing workflows is welcome. However, AI tools should support your judgment — they should not replace your ability to understand the actual conversation. The Most Important Skill For us, one of the most important abilities is this: Can you understand what makes a person interesting? A technically perfect edit is not enough if the editor misses the strongest idea in the interview. We want someone who can recognize when a speaker says something intelligent, surprising, emotional, controversial, memorable, or highly relevant — and knows how to turn that moment into a strong video. How to Apply Please include: Your CV or brief introduction Your portfolio 2–5 examples of your strongest video editing work At least one example involving an interview, speech, podcast, documentary, or people-focused video if available A short explanation of which video in your portfolio you believe demonstrates your storytelling ability best This is a fully remote position. Applicants from outside South Africa are welcome to apply. 2. Video Editor – Interviews, Storytelling & International Content LinkedIn Location: Malaysia Workplace Type: Fully Remote / Online Employment Type: Remote Position About the Role We are looking for a creative and highly perceptive Video Editor to work primarily on interviews, international conversations, speeches, professional events, and human-centered stories . This is a fully remote online position . The job is being advertised through LinkedIn in Malaysia in order to reach talented candidates in the region, but you are not required to live in Malaysia . Applications are welcome from qualified candidates in other countries as well. We are especially interested in editors who are curious about people, cultures, ideas, and different ways of thinking . You should not approach an interview simply as a collection of clips. You should be able to understand: Who is speaking, why their perspective matters, what their strongest idea is, and how to present that person in a way that makes an audience care. Nature of the Content The content may involve: Entrepreneurs and founders Government representatives International professionals Researchers and academics Technology specialists Executives Young professionals Community leaders International conference participants People from developing and developed countries Speakers from different cultural and professional backgrounds Because of this, cultural sensitivity and empathy are very important . Different people communicate differently. Some speakers may be energetic and expressive. Others may be quiet, thoughtful, technical, or reserved. A strong editor should understand those differences and avoid forcing every person into the same editing style. Main Responsibilities Your responsibilities will include: Watching and understanding long-form interview footage. Selecting the strongest parts of each conversation. Identifying memorable quotes and insights. Finding strong hooks for the opening of short videos. Creating 30-second, 60-second, and several-minute social-media edits. Editing complete interviews and speeches. Creating highlight videos from events and conversations. Structuring clips so that they tell a clear story. Improving pacing without destroying natural conversation. Using silence and pauses intentionally when they strengthen the message. Highlighting important statements through captions, graphics, and visual emphasis. Adding B-roll where it genuinely improves understanding. Selecting suitable music and sound design. Cleaning and balancing audio. Creating professional subtitles. Paying close attention to pronunciation, names, countries, organizations, and technical terminology. Understanding context before making editorial decisions. Suggesting alternative edits or creative approaches when you believe they will improve the final result. Human Insight Is Important This position requires more than software skills. For example, imagine you receive a 45-minute interview . We may ask you to identify: The best 60-second clip. The most emotionally powerful moment. The most intelligent or surprising idea. The best opening sentence. The section most suitable for LinkedIn. The section most suitable for Instagram, TikTok, or YouTube Shorts. What makes this particular person worth listening to. We want an editor who can make those decisions intelligently. Communication Skills Strong communication is also important because you may need to discuss: Why you selected a particular clip. Why you removed a section. Why a video should start at a particular moment. Whether an interview should feel serious, emotional, energetic, intellectual, or inspirational. What you believe the audience will respond to. We value editors who can think and communicate like creative partners , not only execute technical instructions. Requirements The ideal candidate should have: Professional video editing experience. A strong portfolio. Experience with interview, documentary, podcast, speech, event, or social-media editing. Excellent English comprehension. Strong storytelling ability. Good communication skills. Strong empathy. Cultural awareness. Curiosity about people and ideas. Ability to understand different accents and communication styles. Strong attention to detail. Ability to work remotely and independently. Reliability and good time management. Ability to accept feedback professionally. Ability to meet deadlines consistently. Editing Tools Experience with any of the following is useful: Adobe Premiere Pro After Effects DaVinci Resolve Final Cut Pro CapCut Descript Adobe Audition AI video tools AI transcription tools AI-assisted content analysis Knowledge of short-form content editing and social-media storytelling will be a strong advantage. What Will Make You Stand Out You will stand out if you can demonstrate that you are good at: Interview storytelling Understanding personalities Identifying strong ideas Editing international speakers Creating emotional connection Making professional speakers more engaging Finding excellent short-form clips from long-form conversations Creating strong first 2–5 seconds Maintaining natural human emotion rather than over-editing everything

new_matches.title: Procurement Manager - Renewable Energy / Solar | Wind (USS / GSS / PSS & Civil Structures) | EHV Infrastructure

The incumbent will drive sourcing excellence, vendor development, cost optimisation, and compliance with CEA/CERC standards and internal governance framework. Key Responsibilities A. B. Wind Energy Substation Procurement — USS / GSS / PSS This role requires deep expertise in procurement of the complete wind project substation hierarchy: Unit Substation (USS) → Grid Substation (GSS) → Pool Substation (PSS), along with all associated electrical equipment and structural systems. B1. Unit Substation (USS) — Wind Turbine Level • Procure USS (typically 0.69/0.9 kV – 33/66 kV) equipment at each wind turbine generator (WTG) pad: WTG step-up transformers (dry-type or oil-cooled), LV/MV switchgear, and MV vacuum circuit breakers (VCBs). • Source USS enclosures, structural skids, grounding systems, surge protection devices (SPDs), and LV distribution boards. • Manage procurement of WTG ring main units (RMUs), cable termination kits, MV cable joints, and inter-array cable systems (33 kV XLPE underground cables). • Coordinate with WTG OEMs (Vestas, Siemens Gamesa, GE, Suzlon, Envision, Inox) for USS interface specifications and IEC compliance requirements. B2. Grid Substation (GSS) — Collection Substation Level • Lead procurement of GSS equipment aggregating power from multiple USS strings, typically operating at 33 kV / 66 kV / 110 kV voltage levels. • Source GSS power transformers (33/110 kV or 66/132 kV), GIS/AIS switchgear panels, bus bar systems, CTs, PTs, CVTs, and LA/surge arresters. • Manage procurement of GSS protection panels (distance relay, differential relay, REF, overcurrent), SCADA RTUs, and energy metering systems. • Procure GSS civil works packages: pre-engineered buildings (PEB), transformer oil containment pits, cable trenches, drainage, fencing, and access roads. • Source GSS auxiliary systems: DC battery chargers, ACDB/DCDB panels, fire detection & suppression systems, and earthing/lightning protection networks. • Manage RFQ for GSS-level SCADA, RTU integration with wind farm SCADA (WPS), and telecom/fibre-optic infrastructure. B3. Pool Substation (PSS) — Central Wind Farm Substation • Lead procurement of PSS (also referred to as main receiving substation or central pooling substation) equipment operating at 132 kV, 220 kV, or 400 kV levels. • Source PSS EHV power transformers (132/220/400 kV, autotransformers where applicable), GIS/AIS switchgear bays, bus coupler panels, and tie-line equipment. • Manage procurement of PSS protection & control (P&C) panels, numerical relays (line differential, distance, busbar protection), inter-tripping equipment, and PLCC systems. • Source PSS metering cubicles, trivector meters (NABL certified), RLDC/SLDC telemetry and SCADA integration equipment. • Procure PSS civil and structural works: RCC/steel control room buildings, cable trenches, transformer bays, oil containment, boundary walls, and site infrastructure. • Manage statutory approvals and equipment interface documentation with PGCIL/STU/DISCOM for PSS commissioning and grid synchronisation. C. Wind Project Civil & Structural Procurement — 2-Pole & 4-Pole Systems Expertise required in procurement of 2-pole and 4-pole gantry/portal structures used across USS, GSS, and PSS switchyards for conductor termination, bus support, and equipment mounting. Structure Type Application in Wind Projects Key Procurement Scope 2-Pole Structure (A- type / Portal Frame) WTG yard, USS switchyard, GSS 33/66 kV bays, incoming and outgoing line terminations Galvanised MS/GI tubular/lattice poles, crossarms, base plates, anchor bolts, clamps, hardware; fabrication, hot-dip galvanising, and erection contracts 4-Pole Structure (Gantry / H-Frame) GSS and PSS EHV bays (132 kV / 220 kV / 400 kV), bus-bar support structures, equipment platforms, maintenance walkways Structural steel sections (IS 2062), lattice gantry fabrication, galvanising as per IS 4759, levelling pads, foundation bolts, grouting kits; civil foundation works Pole-Mounted Equipment Structures LA/SA mounting, CT/PT mounting, isolator support structures at USS/GSS level Steel channels, angle iron frameworks, pre- galvanised structural hardware, insulator strings, conductor stringing accessories Earthing & Lightning Protection Earth mat, earth electrode, earth strips across USS/GSS/PSS, lightning masts Copper earth strips/rods, GI earth wire, lightning masts (30m/45m), bonding connectors, surge counter meters • Manage procurement of civil foundation works for 2-pole and 4-pole structures: soil investigation, PCC/RCC foundations, stub setting, and backfill. • Source structural steel from SAIL/TATA/JSW-approved mills; ensure IS 2062 Grade compliance, dimensional tolerances, and hot-dip galvanising as per IS 4759. • Coordinate structural design review with Civil/Structural Engineering team and ensure procurement aligns with approved GADs (General Arrangement Drawings). • Manage erection sub-contracts for structural steel work, switchyard civil works, and cabling within USS, GSS, and PSS boundaries. D. EHV Transmission & Grid Infrastructure Procurement • Lead procurement of EHV transmission line materials: ACSR/ACCC/HTLS conductors, ground wires (OPGW/GW), lattice/tubular towers (2-pole/4-pole/delta), disc/string insulators, and hardware fittings. • Source EHV cables (132/220/400 kV XLPE), cable accessories (joints, terminations), and cable management systems for underground sections. • Manage sourcing of PGCIL/STU-grade EHV switchgear: SF6/GIS bays, line isolators, bus isolators, earth switches, and interlocking systems. • Ensure all EHV equipment meets CEA Technical Standards, IS/IEC 60076/62271/60826, and Grid Code requirements; manage FAT/SAT documentation. • Liaise with PGCIL, STUs, and DISCOMs for bay allocation, connectivity milestones, and long-lead equipment planning. E. Solar Equipment Procurement • Oversee procurement of solar PV modules (mono PERC, TOPCon, Bifacial HJT), string/central/hybrid inverters, DC cables, mounting structures, and BoP components. • Source site SCADA, monitoring systems, BESS (Battery Energy Storage Systems), and hybrid integration equipment as required by project scope. • Ensure ALMM compliance for solar modules and cells; manage vendor qualification under BIS/IEC certification requirements. G. Contract, Compliance & Governance • Draft, review, and negotiate procurement contracts (LOIs, MSAs, POs, EPC sub-contracts) in coordination with Legal & Finance teams. • Ensure compliance with MNRE, CERC, CEA, and applicable state regulations across all procurement activities. • Adhere to DoA (Delegation of Authority), procurement governance policies, and internal control frameworks. • Support statutory, internal, and lender audits including project financing due diligence documentation. H. Project Coordination & Logistics • Coordinate with Project Management, Civil & Electrical Engineering, O&M, and Grid Connectivity teams for integrated material planning and delivery schedules. • Manage ODC/OWC (Over Dimensional Consignment / Overweight Consignment) transport for large EHV transformers, WTG nacelles, blades, and tower sections. • Oversee customs clearance for imported equipment, freight management, and last-mile delivery to remote wind/solar sites. • Maintain a critical path procurement tracker and proactively manage supply chain risks to avoid project delays. I. Reporting & Analytics • Deliver procurement MIS dashboards to senior leadership: spend analytics, savings achieved, vendor KPIs, delivery performance, and USS/GSS/PSS equipment status. Qualifications & Experience Educational Qualifications • B.E./B.Tech in Electrical Engineering — mandatory (essential for EHV and wind substation domains). • M.E./M.Tech in Power Systems or MBA in Supply Chain / Operations / Finance — preferred. • Certification in Supply Chain Management (CPSM, CIPS) or Project Management (PMP) is an added advantage. Work Experience • 10–12 years of progressive experience in procurement, sourcing, or supply chain management in the power or renewable energy sector. • Minimum 4–5 years in solar energy procurement (modules, inverters, BoP, SCADA, mounting systems). • Minimum 3–4 years in wind energy procurement with specific exposure to USS, GSS, and PSS substation equipment and 2-pole / 4-pole structural systems. • Minimum 3 years in EHV infrastructure procurement (132 kV and above) — substations, transmission lines, GIS/AIS switchgear, protection systems. • Prior experience managing procurement budgets of INR 150 Cr+ per annum across multi-technology renewable energy projects. • Hands-on experience with PGCIL/STU connectivity procedures, SECI/NTPC EPC contracts, and state DISCOM coordination.

new_matches.title: Director Consulting Services - Rail Infra
new_matches.description: Functiebeschrijving (Note: This job posting is only open to native level or near-native level Dutch speakers . If you are not proficient in Dutch, please have a look at our other job postings instead!) Spreek jij native of near-native Nederlands? Lees dan verder! Wil jij bijdragen aan de digitale transformatie van de spoorsector en zo meebouwen aan de toekomst van duurzame mobiliteit? De spoorwegen staan voor grote uitdagingen: de groeiende vraag naar capaciteit en de behoefte aan innovatieve, slimme oplossingen vereisen verdere digitalisering en modernisering van businessprocessen en IT-oplossingen. We bieden jou de kans om deel uit te maken van deze transformatie, waarbij continue innovatie en ontwikkeling centraal staan. Doe jij mee? Jouw rol in ons team Als Director ben jij de drijvende kracht achter de verdere groei van onze Rail Unit. In nauwe samenwerking met je collega Directors en leidinggevende in ons managementteam, bouw je aan sterke klantrelaties en werk je aan baanbrekende, innovatieve oplossingen voor de railsector om onze positie in de markt verder te ontwikkelen en te versterken. Je krijgt veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid om onze diensten te verbeteren en te vernieuwen. Je richt je op het waarborgen van uitstekende klanttevredenheid, het behalen van commerciële doelstellingen en het creëren van een cultuur waarin je team optimaal presteert en continu blijft groeien. Je stelt zelf je team samen en bepaalt hoe dit groeit, van jonge talentvolle mensen tot ervaren professionals. Om verbonden te blijven met je klant, je team en de markt, ben je zelf voor ongeveer de helft van je tijd ingezet binnen projecten. Flexibiliteit in werkplek en werkinvulling is mogelijk, afhankelijk van de behoeften van onze klanten. Onze grootste klant, de beheerder van de Nederlandse Railinfrastructuur, staat voor de uitdaging om innovatieve oplossingen te realiseren en zo aan de snel toenemende vraag naar spoorcapaciteit te voldoen. Uitbouwen van het spoorwegnet is slechts beperkt mogelijk. Het moet daarom slimmer en sneller, waardoor vernieuwing van het IT landschap essentieel is. Je helpt onze klant daarom met de automatisering van business processen en de verdere modernisering van het IT-landschap. Je draagt daarmee bij aan het realiseren van haar uitdagende ambities, zoals De implementatie van het nieuwe Europese beveiligingssysteem ERTMS; Slimmere planning en uitvoering van de dienstregeling; Het verhogen van de beschikbaarheid en efficiëntie van het spoor. Hoe jij ons team versterkt Je hebt ervaring met: Business development, sales en delivery binnen complexe technische of infrastructuuromgevingen; Het leiden en coachen van teams van 10-15 medewerkers; Contract- en financieelmanagement; De railsector of vergelijkbare technische domeinen, zoals mobiliteit of logistiek. Je bent: Ondernemend, proactief en resultaatgericht; Een teamspeler die anderen inspireert en weet te overtuigen van ideeën; In staat om samen met je team complexe klantvragen om te zetten in innovatieve en toekomstgerichte oplossingen. Je beschikt over: Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden in het Nederlands en Engels, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk. Een afgeronde HBO/WO opleiding. Een pre-employment screening maakt onderdeel uit van de sollicitatieprocedure Waarom CGI CGI is één van 's werelds grootste IT-consultancy bedrijven. Onze mensen houden Nederland draaiende. Overheidsinstellingen, banken, lucht- en ruimtevaart, infrastructurele organisaties en energie- en productiebedrijven zijn klanten van CGI. We werken aan interessante projecten die het alledaagse leven van miljoenen mensen raken. We zijn regionaal aanwezig, versterkt met wereldwijde domeinkennis, ons ecosysteem en collega's verspreid over de hele wereld. We zijn trots op de impactvolle projecten die we samen met onze collega’s tot een succes maken. Bij CGI hechten we veel waarde aan diversiteit, inclusie en gelijkwaardigheid, omdat dit niet alleen de samenwerking bevordert, maar ook leidt tot betere resultaten. We voeren actief beleid om mensen met een afstand tot de arbeidsmarkt een plek te geven in onze unit. We kijken uit naar jouw bijdrage aan ons team! We werken bij CGI in kleine zelfsturende teams bestaande uit experts in je vakgebied. De regie over je eigen carrière met daarbij de ruimte om jezelf te blijven ontwikkelen. Je werkt met de nieuwste technologieën. Een uitstekend salaris en aantrekkelijke secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden Direct een vast contract Parttime mogelijkheden De mogelijkheid om CGI aandeelhouder te worden CGI Rail, gevestigd in Rotterdam werkt aan de transformatie van railsystemen die essentieel zijn voor de besturing van het Nederlandse spoorwegnet. Je komt te werken in onze gezellige RainInfra Unit binnen de sector Rail en Public Transport. Daarin speel je een cruciale rol in de uitdaging om verouderde IT-systemen in de spoorwegsector te vernieuwen en nieuwe systemen toe te voegen. Deze systemen zijn verantwoordelijk voor de aansturing van seinen en wissels en het leveren van informatie aan treindienstleiders en andere afnemers, zoals treinposities en wisselstanden. Daarnaast ontwikkelen wij voor de spoorsector en onze klant simulatiesystemen voor het opleiden van treindienstleiders en het testen van praktijkveranderingen met 3D visualisaties voor machinisten. Sluit je aan bij ons team van experts en solliciteer direct! Meer informatie over de inhoud van de vacature? Neem contact op met Vice President Consulting Services, Gert Jan Spierenburg gertjan.spierenburg@cgi.com. Vragen over de sollicitatieprocedure? Neem contact op met Recruitment business partner Natrah Pula via 06 11218723 of via Natrah.pula@cgi.com. Wij werken niet samen met externe recruitment-partijen. Acquisitie naar aanleiding van onze vacatures wordt daarom niet op prijs gesteld! Taken en verantwoordelijkheden Criteria Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action. In 1976 opgericht als een familiebedrijf, is CGI vandaag de dag een van de grootste onafhankelijke zakelijke en ICT-dienstverleners ter wereld. Bij ons draait het om ownership, teamwork en respect. Je krijgt de ruimte om al je talenten volledig te ontplooien. Vanaf je eerste werkdag ben je mede-eigenaar van CGI. We profiteren samen van ons succes en je krijgt de kans én verantwoordelijkheid om actief bij te dragen aan de koers en strategie van ons bedrijf. Jouw inzet voegt waarde toe. Je werkt aan innovatieve oplossingen en bouwt aan je netwerk van collega's en klanten. Je hebt toegang tot wereldwijde kansen om je ideeën te realiseren, mogelijkheden te benutten en te profiteren van onze kennis van de industrie en technologische expertise. Ontdek bij ons de mogelijkheden voor jouw persoonlijke ontwikkeling en zet de volgende stap in je carrière. Hier staat jouw succes centraal!

Ottima conoscenza della lingua italiana COSA OFFRIAMO Inserimento diretto in una realtà industriale in forte crescita e orientata all'innovazione; PC e smartphone aziendali ; Percorsi di formazione tecnica, linguistica e manageriale ; Concrete opportunità di crescita professionale e acquisizione di responsabilità ; Possibilità di lavorare su progetti innovativi nei settori dell'automazione industriale, delle energie rinnovabili e della transizione energetica; Opportunità di entrare in contatto con team e interlocutori internazionali ; Possibilità di partecipare ad attività di ricerca e sviluppo . new_matches.description: CMCC Position cod. 12839 Impact Modeller – Climate Risks, Energy Systems and Socio-Economic Resilience Deadline: September 15th, 2026 What We Are Looking For We are seeking two outstanding/ambitious mid-level researchers with a strong track record in climate impact modelling, environmental systems modelling, integrated assessment, or related disciplines to join the European Institute on Economics and the Environment (EIEE) at the CMCC Foundation in Milan, Italy. The successful candidates will contribute to the scientific development of next-generation climate impact modelling frameworks supporting climate adaptation, energy transitions, and resilience planning across vulnerable regions worldwide. The position focuses on understanding how climate change propagates through interconnected human and natural systems, affecting energy systems, water resources, ecosystems, food production, infrastructure, and socio-economic development. The successful candidate will lead the development of integrated modelling approaches capable of translating climate hazards into actionable information for decision-makers and supporting evidence-based adaptation strategies. A particular emphasis will be placed on modelling climate impacts across interconnected human and natural systems, including water resources, energy systems, food systems, biodiversity, and ecosystem services, integrating Earth system information with impact models, socio-economic analysis, artificial intelligence, and decision-support tools to support climate adaptation, resilience, and sustainable development. The successful candidates will play a leading role in shaping a new generation of modular, scalable, and policy-relevant impact modelling frameworks, working within interdisciplinary teams spanning climate science, engineering, economics, AI, and environmental systems analysis. Beyond scientific research, the position offers the opportunity to coordinate international research activities, supervise junior researchers and PhD students, contribute to strategic project development, and help shape the future research agenda of EIEE in climate impacts, adaptation, and resilience. About Us CMCC Foundation is a cross-cutting scientific research center on climate change and its interactions with the environment, society, the world of business, and policymakers. Our work aims to stimulate sustainable growth, protect the environment, and develop strategies for the adaptation and mitigation of climate change. CMCC's core objective is to conduct cutting-edge science, to train the next generation of scientists at both national and international levels, and to be a beacon for climate modelling. CMCC pursues fundamental and applied science with utmost scientific integrity, prioritizing data-driven science and providing data, information, and research results that can support informed public debate and decision-making processes. To achieve climate research objectives at the highest international standards, we invest in training all our talents, and strive to create a workplace where everyone can excel. At CMCC you will find a strong, professional environment. Join an inclusive community that values diversity, where every voice is heard and respected. Help foster a culture of innovation and societal change, where individuals from all backgrounds can thrive and succeed. Over the last decade, CMCC has experienced extraordinary growth. We are now embarking on a new chapter of our journey that will further boost CMCC’s global position in climate change research…Together! To learn more about this opportunity and submit your application, please refer to the following: ROLE The successful candidates will work within the European Institute on Economics and the Environment (EIEE), contributing to the scientific leadership of research activities on climate impacts, resilience, and integrated environmental modelling. The selected mid-level researchers will contribute to the development of innovative modelling frameworks, coordinate interdisciplinary research activities, support project management of large international projects, supervise junior researchers, and actively contribute to the preparation of competitive national and international research proposals. Responsibilities The selected candidates will: Lead the development of integrated climate impact modelling frameworks linking climate information with energy systems, socio-economic systems and adaptation strategies Coordinate scientific activities across interdisciplinary teams working on climate science, economics, engineering, artificial intelligence and environmental modelling Design and implement multi-sectoral climate impact assessments and resilience analyses under future climate and socio-economic scenarios Develop innovative methodologies integrating Earth system information, impact models, AI techniques and decision-support systems Lead the development of climate risk, vulnerability and resilience indicators to support policy and investment decisions Contribute to the scientific coordination and project management of large collaborative national and international research projects Supervise PhD students, postdoctoral researchers and early-career scientists Develop new research directions and strengthen collaborations with leading international research institutions Contribute actively to fundraising activities, including the preparation and coordination of competitive research proposals (e.g. Horizon Europe, ERC, international foundations and philanthropic initiatives) Publish high-quality scientific research in leading international journals and represent CMCC and the EIEE Institute in international scientific networks and conferences Contribute strategically to the scientific development and long-term objectives of the EIEE Institute Requirements Mandatory requirements: PhD in Environmental Engineering, Environmental Sciences, Climate Science, Physics, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics or related disciplines Demonstrated experience in climate impact modelling, integrated assessment, Earth system applications, environmental modelling or related quantitative disciplines Strong programming skills in Python and experience with scientific computing and environmental datasets Experience in developing models, scenario analysis and quantitative assessment frameworks Proven scientific publication record in peer-reviewed international journals Experience working in interdisciplinary and international research environments Excellent communication and scientific writing skills Proficiency in English (spoken and written, Italian not required), with strong writing and presentation skills Willingness to travel for project meetings and conferences Ability to work effectively in an interdisciplinary and international research environment Preferred qualifications: 3–8 years of postdoctoral or equivalent research experience Experience coordinating research tasks or interdisciplinary work packages Experience supervising MSc students, PhD students or early-career researchers Experience in successful proposal writing and fundraising for competitive research projects Experience interacting with stakeholders and policy-oriented research Experience with AI/data-driven methods applied to environmental systems Familiarity with Earth System Models, Integrated Assessment Models, energy system models or climate services Duration, Compensation & Benefits Please note that this opportunity will be issued both internally and externally. The selected mid-level researchers will be based in Milan CMCC office The contract offered for this position will be a Coordinated and Continuous Collaboration contract, starting no earlier than 1 October 2026 and lasting for 12-24 months. The gross annual salary range for this position is 40-55K Euros. The salary offered within the range will be determined based on years of relevant experience, level of seniority, specific technical skills, applying objective and gender-neutral criteria Welfare package of 2,000 Euro per year. Flexible working time as per internal policies Support during the immigration process, if needed PROTECTED CATEGORY Belonging to legally protected categories (ex L. 68/99) will constitute a preferential condition. Some fiscal benefits could be applied for repatriated workers or foreign researchers/professors, having the requirements defined by Dlgs 147/2015 (for repatriates) or Dl 78/2010 (for foreigners). CMCC is an equal-opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, age, familial status, and other legally protected characteristics. Please omit from your CV any data you or we might consider discriminatory. This job announcement is an invitation to express interest in the above-mentioned CMCC Position. By submitting their application, candidates confirm that they have read, understood, and accepted the CMCC Personnel Recruitment Rules, available on the 'Fondazione Trasparente' webpage, as well as the Privacy Notice regarding the processing of personal data, accessible at the following link. We will keep your information on file for up to 1 year.

new_matches.title: Project Development and Reporting Officer (P)
new_matches.description: Job Description Introduction Established in 1951, IOM is a Related Organization of the United Nations and the leading UN agency in the field of migration. Working closely with governmental, intergovernmental and non-governmental partners, IOM promotes humane and orderly migration for the benefit of all. It saves lives and protects people on the move, drives solutions to displacement, and facilitates pathways for regular migration, while providing services and advice to governments and migrants. IOM is committed to fostering a respectful, inclusive and supportive workplace where all employees can thrive professionally and feel valued. By creating such an environment, IOM aims to better harness the full potential of migration and strengthen its support to people on the move. IOM invites candidates from diverse backgrounds to apply and provides reasonable accommodation throughout the recruitment process when required. Learn more about IOM’s workplace culture at IOM workplace culture | International Organization for Migration. Applications are welcome from first- and second-tier candidates, particularly qualified female candidates as well as applications from the non-represented member countries of IOM. For all IOM vacancies, applications from qualified and eligible first-tier candidates are considered before those of qualified and eligible second-tier candidates in the selection process. For the purpose of this vacancy, the following are considered first-tier candidates: Internal candidates Candidates from the following IOM Member States that are not represented among staff members in the Professional and higher categories: Bahamas, Barbados, Cabo Verde, Comoros, Congo (the), Cook Islands, Dominica, Federated States of Micronesia, Grenada, Guinea-Bissau, Holy See, Iceland, Israel, Kiribati, Marshall Islands, Namibia, Nauru, Palau, Saint Kitts and Nevis, Saint Lucia, Samoa, Sao Tome and Principe, Seychelles, Solomon Islands, Suriname, Timor-Leste, Tonga, Trinidad and Tobago, Tuvalu, Vanuatu Second Tier Candidates Include All external candidates, except candidates from non-represented member states of IOM. Organizational Context and Scope Under the overall supervision of the Chief of Mission (COM) and direct supervision of the PSU Coordinator, and in close collaboration with the Deputy Chief of Mission (DCOM) and relevant units at the Regional Office and Headquarters (HQ), the Project Development and Reporting Officer will be responsible and accountable for supporting the coordination and facilitation of project development, donor and institutional reporting in the fields of migration management, emergency response, as well as assisting with liaison activities with counterparts in the government, UN agencies and other relevant stakeholders in line with IOM’s regional and country strategies. Responsibilities Contribute to the development of results-based programmes and projects, concept notes and project proposals, in close coordination with the DCOM, PSU Coordinator, Project Managers, UNCT, relevant donors, government counterparts and project partners, by providing technical inputs and support that respond to emerging trends and priorities and that are in compliance with IOM and donor interests and requirements. Review resource requirements, document programmatic needs, gaps and opportunities. Contribute to the alignment with IOM global, regional and country strategies during project development and donor reporting, including supporting and promoting the use of the Strategic Results Framework (SRF) global results and indicators. Support the endorsement process for concept notes and project proposals. Support the Project Managers in drafting donor reports in close coordination with relevant units in the CO and RO in line with IOM policies, standards and internal procedures. Research potential and realistic funding opportunities among government and non-government donors, review calls for proposals and collect donor information. Draft donor profiles and guidance notes on donor priorities, and assist with developing approaches to expand the IOM donor base. Support effective working relationships with donor counterparts and project/programme partners, such as government authorities, diplomatic missions, and other relevant agencies and working groups. In coordination with relevant Units in the CO, draft visibility and other resource mobilization materials and organize donor briefings and visits. Capacity building and training activities in the field of programme development, donor and institutional reporting, and the roll-out of the SRF for CO’s staff through workshops and seminars. In support of knowledge management, maintain accurate, updated, and pertinent records of all correspondence, project development, and donor and institutional reporting files, and related information in IOM’s relevant software application. Perform such other duties as may be assigned. Qualifications Required Qualifications and Experience Education Master’s degree in International Relations, International Development, Political or Social Sciences, Migration Studies, Law, or a related field from an accredited academic institution with two years of relevant professional experience; or, University degree in the above fields with four years of relevant professional experience . Accredited Universities are those listed in the UNESCO World Higher Education Database. Experience Experience in supporting results-based project development and reporting, technical writing and editing, preferably in the international development/humanitarian sector; and, Work experience in donor relations and grant management for specific donors of IOM’s interest. Skills Good communication, writing and organizational skills; ability to prepare clear and concise reports; Basic knowledge of monitoring and evaluation concepts, approaches and methodologies; Confirmed experience in donor report writing in humanitarian and/or development settings; Experience with Results-Based Management approach and other strategic planning approaches; Strong analytical and planning skills; capacity to establish working relationships with governmental authorities, national and international institutions and Non-Governmental Organizations; Capacity to supervise and train support staff; ability to work effectively and harmoniously with colleagues from varied cultures and professional backgrounds; Ability to work with accuracy under constraints and pressure; high sense of confidentiality, initiative and good judgment; Personal commitment, efficiency, flexibility, drive for results, creative thinking; and, Good level of computer literacy, including database applications. Languages For this position, fluency in English is required (oral and written). Working knowledge of another official UN languages (Arabic, Chinese, French, Russian, and Spanish) is an advantage. Proficiency of language(s) required will be specifically evaluated during the selection process, which may include written and/or oral assessments. Required Competencies IOM’s competency framework can be found at this link . Competencies will be assessed during the selection process. Values - all IOM staff members must abide by and demonstrate these five values: Inclusion and respect for diversity: Respects and promotes individual and cultural differences. Encourages diversity and inclusion. Integrity and transparency: Maintains high ethical standards and acts in a manner consistent with organizational principles/rules and standards of conduct. Professionalism: Demonstrates ability to work in a composed, competent and committed manner and exercises careful judgment in meeting day-to-day challenges. Courage: Demonstrates willingness to take a stand on issues of importance. Empathy: Shows compassion for others, makes people feel safe, respected and fairly treated. Core Competencies – behavioural indicators Level 2 Teamwork: Develops and promotes effective collaboration within and across units to achieve shared goals and optimize results. Delivering results: Produces and delivers quality results in a service-oriented and timely manner. Is action-oriented and committed to achieving agreed outcomes. Managing and sharing knowledge: Continuously seeks to learn, share knowledge and innovate. Accountability: Takes ownership for achieving the Organization’s priorities and assumes responsibility for own actions and delegated work. Communication: Encourages and contributes to clear and open communication. Explains complex matters in an informative, inspiring and motivational way. Managerial Competencies – behavioural indicators Level 2 Leadership: Provides a clear sense of direction, leads by example and demonstrates the ability to carry out the Organization’s vision. Assists others to realize and develop their leadership and professional potential. Empowering others: Creates an enabling environment where staff can contribute their best and develop their potential. Building Trust: Promotes shared values and creates an atmosphere of trust and honesty. Strategic thinking and vision: Works strategically to realize the Organization’s goals and communicates a clear strategic direction. Humility: Leads with humility and shows openness to acknowledging own shortcomings. Notes Internationally recruited professional staff are required to be mobile. Please refer to this link for guidance on IOM Job Category. Any offer made to the candidate in relation to this vacancy notice is subject to funding confirmation. This selection process may be used to staff similar positions in various duty stations. Recommended candidates will remain eligible to be appointed in a similar position for a period of 24 months. Appointment will be subject to all clearances, including medical and security, as well as accreditation, and any residency or visa requirements. Vacancies close at 23:59 local time in Geneva, Switzerland on the respective closing date. No late applications will be accepted. IOM has a zero-tolerance policy on conduct that is incompatible with the aims and objectives of the United Nations and IOM, including sexual exploitation and abuse, harassment, sexual harassment, abuse of authority and any forms of discrimination. IOM is committed to promote the protection and safeguarding of all children. IOM conducts reference checks and background verification, including through system-wide databases such as ClearCheck, to help ensure that candidates have no record of misconduct, including on sexual harassment, sexual exploitation and abuse, or fraud.
